At just 18 months old, Tori is still very much a youngster and has plenty to learn.  She is an affectionate, enthusiastic girl who loves getting out and about, but she will need a very special home that understands her needs and can keep up with her busy lifestyle.  Tori is an extremely energetic girl who can sometimes be quite a handful.  She loves spending time in our secure compound, where she can chase her favourite balls and burn off some of that endless energy.  She also thoroughly enjoys long walks, exploring her surroundings and taking in all the sights and smells along the way.  Kennel life can be difficult for Tori.  She can be whiny and vocal, and she has been known to jump over the kennel walls.  She also chews toys and bedding and does get very frustrated.  A German Shepherd needs more than just three walks a day.  They are an intelligent working breed who thrive when they have a purpose.  They need a job to do, both mentally and physically, and will benefit from activities that challenge their minds as well as exercise their bodies.  Whether that’s scent work, training, tracking, problem-solving games, enrichment activities or learning new skills, they need to be kept occupied and given an outlet for their natural instincts. Tori needs an adopter who understands a tired mind is just as important as a tired body.  She will need an experienced adopter who has worked with the breed before.  Tori needs a secure private garden and someone who is around most of the day.  Please only apply if you have the experience and commitment to give Tori what she needs.

Tori has socialised with other dogs while in our care and can be very vocal and does get frustrated around them.  So we feel she would be best rehomed as the only dog where her committed owner will continue her socialisation around other dogs in a controlled environment with lots of positive reinforcement.

As Tori came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on her, so would prefer any children/visiting children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Rufus
description:
Meet Rufus our gorgeous goofball! (46kg).  He is looking for an experienced home where he can continue to learn and enjoy all the love and attention he deserves.  When Rufus first arrived, he was a nervous boy and could be a bit growly while he found his feet.  However, he has now come out of his shell and what a character he is!  He’s a friendly and affectionate lad who absolutely loves a fuss and being around people.  Rufus is a big boy with an equally big personality.  He’s giddy, playful and full of enthusiasm.  He loves his toys and often likes to carry two around in his mouth at once.  He also has a habit of using your leg as a handy resting place for his toys while he is playing with them, unfortunately he doesn’t always realise when he is chewing his toy that he has nipped legs by accident on occasion.  One thing potential adopters really need to be aware of is Rufus’s strength.   He is very strong on the lead and does pull a lot.  He will need further lead training and an experienced handler who is physically capable of managing large, powerful and boisterous dog.  Rufus can also become a little mouthy when he’s overexcited, so he’ll need someone who understands this behaviour and is happy to continue working on his manners and impulse control.  Rufus is looking for an experienced owner who has previously owned large, strong and energetic dogs.  An owner committed to ongoing training, particularly lead manners, excitement management and learning appropriate boundaries.  Someone who understands that his size and enthusiasm can sometimes get the better of him.  Rufus has so much potential and, underneath all that strength and silliness, there’s an affectionate boy who wants to enjoy life and be someone’s special companion.  He will need a private secure garden.

Rufus has socialised well with other dogs while in our care, but we feel he would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home where he can get 100% of the attention and training he needs.

As Rufus came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children/visiting children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Apollo
description:
Apollo arrived into our care as a stray he was very reserved and shy. He was very unsure of new people, a lead and going for walks. With some love and attention he is now slowly starting to realise that the world isn’t such a scary place. He is still a little unsure of new surroundings so will need a patient home that has time to help him settle in. As he is gaining confidence he is starting to be a very affectionate boy with both staff and volunteers. He is full on and loves to jump all over you and give you lots of kisses!

Apollo needs a calm home with a patient family that has the time to allow him to settle into a new environment. He may need basic training once he has settled and his personality starts to come through. He is going to be a fantastic companion with the right home and a lot time. Apollo needs a home that has owned dogs previously.

Apollo can be rehomed with children who are 16 years and over – subject to a successful meet.

Apollo has interacted well with dogs whilst out on walks, he is very gentle and calm, so he could potentially be rehomed with another dog – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Arlo
description:
Arlo is a gorgeous, sweet-natured boy who is very friendly and absolutely loves lots of fuss.  He’s a real people dog and enjoys getting plenty of attention and affection.  He is a very energetic and boisterous lad who can get extremely giddy when he’s excited.  He sometimes forgets just how big he is and will jump up to say hello, so he would benefit from some basic training to help him learn his manners and channel all that enthusiasm. Arlo loves running around in our compound area, getting out lots of energy with a case of the zoomies! Arlo is a loveable, fun, lively character with bags of personality.  He would thrive in a very active home with someone who can give him plenty of exercise, long walks and consistency with his training.  He would need a private secure garden so he can practice his zoomies!

Arlo has interacted well with dogs whilst in our care but can be very boisterous and jumpy, he could potentially be rehomed with a dog of a similar size and temperament – subject to a successful meet.

Arlo is best suited to be rehomed with children who are 16 years and over – subject to his successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Reggie
description:
Meet Reggie!  Reggie is a handsome young boy with a big personality and plenty of character!  Reggie is a friendly boy who enjoys interaction and playtime, but he is also a strong-minded lad who will need an experienced owner who understands his breed and can provide clear boundaries, consistency and guidance.  Reggie can become nippy when excited or overstimulated, so his new home will need to be mindful of his arousal levels and understand how to manage and redirect this behaviour appropriately.  He is also very vocal during play, so don’t be surprised if he has plenty to say!  He has some quirky behaviours too.  He loves chasing the hosepipe while staff are cleaning his kennel and can get quite enthusiastic and does rag his bedding.  His new adopter will need to show him how to channel that frustration.  Reggie can be quite dominant and has previously shown some possessive behaviour around his bed, standing over it while staff have attempted to move it.  He also displays some unusual body language at times, although he has been ok with staff during his time in our care.  We are looking for an experienced, confident and patient owner who can recognise and understand his body language, respect his boundaries and work positively with him to help him develop good manners and appropriate behaviours.  Reggie is still a young dog with lots to learn, and with the right home, consistent handling and ongoing training, we know he can continue to make progress.  He isn’t going to be the right match for everyone, but we believe the right person will see the lovely character behind this cheeky little Frenchie.  He will need a private secure garden.

Reggie has interacted with other dogs while in our care and is very humpy with them so we feel he would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home.

As Reggie came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Fizz
description:
Meet Fizz!  Fizz is a beautiful girl with a big personality and bags of character.  She is a friendly, excitable and very playful little lady who is always ready to bring a bit of fun and mischief wherever she goes.  She’s a sassy girl who knows her own mind and certainly isn’t short of personality.  Fizz absolutely loves human company and thrives on attention.  She’s a girl who enjoys being involved in everything and will jump up to say hello and demand some fuss.  She would benefit from continued gentle guidance with her manners and to be shown there are calmer ways to say hello.  When she gets a little overexcited, she does gently nibble at your fingers, but this is all part of her excited and playful nature and is done without any malice.  She’s a giddy, fun-loving girl who loves her walks and enjoys getting out and about to explore.  Whether it’s playtime, walkies or simply spending time with her favourite people. Fizz is happiest when she’s getting attention and being part of the action.  Fizz is looking for a home that will embrace her cheeky character, enjoy her playful ways and give her all the love, time and attention she deserves.  She will need continued guidance on how to manager her excitement.  She would benefit from a private secure garden.

Fizz has interacted with other dogs while in our care, and although she is happy to walk along side them she doesn’t like them in her face or sniffing around her back end so we feel she would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home.

As Fizz came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on her so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Darren
description:
Darren came into our care as a stray so we don’t have any background information about him. He is looking for a very special home with someone who truly understands the unique personality and characteristics of the Shar – Pei Breed. Like many Shar -Pei’s, he is an independent character who enjoys doing things on his own terms. He isn’t fussed about being handled, fussed over or touched and prefers his own personal space respected. He needs an understanding owner who can recognise his body language, respect his boundaries and give him time to build trust at his own pace. Whilst he may not be a cuddly, affectionate dog, he has his own personality and charm.

He really enjoys getting out on walks and it’s great to see him perk up with excitement as soon as he spots the lead, it certainly is the highlight of his day! He is strong on the lead and does pull a lot so he will need more work in this area. He has socialised well with dogs out on walks and has shown that he can be comfortable out in  a group.

Darren needs an experienced adult only home, with no visiting children.

Darren is best suited to being the only dog in the home so he can have his own space.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Theo
description:
Meet Theo! Theo has a big heart and plenty of love to give.  This friendly, affectionate boy absolutely thrives on attention, and the more fuss and cuddles he gets, the happier he is!  Theo loves getting out and about on walks (he does walk better on a harness) but his favourite time of days is his off-lead time in our secure compound where he can run around and chase his favourite toys.  He does know some basic commands like sit, paw and speak and is very eager to please.  Theo can bark to get your attention and tends to jump up when he gets excited.  He will benefit from a family who can continue working with him on his manners and help him learn calmer ways to ask for attention.  Theo is a fun-loving affectionate boy who has so much love to give.  He would love a home where he can enjoy his walks, have plenty of playtime and, most importantly, receive all the love and attention he deserves.  Theo will need a private secure garden so he can safely have off-lead time with his toys.

Theo has socialised with other dogs while in our care, he will have a quick sniff but isn’t too bothered about them, so we feel he would be happiest being the only dog in the home where he can receive 100% of the attention and cuddles.

Theo has a Grade 1 Heart Murmur, this will be discussed in more detail with the successful applicant.

As Theo came into us as a stray we have no previous history on him, so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Jax
description:
Jax is a friendly and affectionate boy who absolutely loves attention and enjoys a good fuss.  He has a wonderful nature and is always happy to spend time with his people. This clever lad is exceptionally well behaved at the vets, taking examinations and handling in his stride, which is a testament to his temperament and trainability.  Like many dogs, he has his own little quirks – one of his favourites is enthusiastically ragging his blankets and rearranging them to his liking!

As a typical Belgian Malinois, he is highly intelligent, energetic and thrives on both physical exercise and mental stimulation.  He loves charging around our compound and would be happiest in a home where he has plenty of opportunities to stay active and engaged.  Jax is very ball focused which is a bonus when it comes to training. Because of his breed traits, he will need an owner who has previous experience with Belgian Malinois and understands their needs.  He is not a dog that will be content with a short walk around the block, he requires ongoing training, enrichment and a lifestyle that allows him to use both his body and brain.  He will need a private secure garden.

We feel that it would be best for Jax to be rehomed with adults only.

Jax is a typical Mali so likes to be vocal around other dogs, he is easily distracted with toys but we feel like he would be best suited to being the only dog in the home so he can have his own space and the focus on him.

No cats or small furries for Jax due to having a very high prey drive. We would recommend not having any cats within your area.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Rudy
description:
Don’t let his age fool you, this lively, energetic boy has plenty of energy and enthusiasm. Rudy is a friendly, excitable and affectionate boy who absolutely loves attention and fuss.  He has a big personality and is not shy about letting you know when he wants you to interact with him!  Rudy can be quite vocal when he wants your attention or, more importantly, when he thinks it’s time for you to throw his ball.  Rudy’s favourite thing to do is chase his toys, and he could happily spend all afternoon playing and having fun.  He also enjoys his long walks and would love an active home who can provide him with plenty of exercise and opportunities to explore.

Rudy is a strong boy on the lead, so his new adopters will need to be confident handling him and willing to continue working on his lead manners.  He does know his basic commands and with the right guidance, could continue to build on these. He would suit someone who enjoys getting out and about and is looking for a fun, lively companion with a larger-than-life  personality.

We think that Rudy could be rehomed with children who are 13 years and over – subject to a successful meet.

Rudy has interacted well with dogs whilst in our care so we believe that he could potentially be rehomed with another dog of similar size and temperament – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Pearl
description:
Pearl came into our care as a stray so we don’t have much of a history on her. She can be a little vocal around people at first but soon warms up with treats. She is a very sweet gentle girl when she knows you and loves a good fuss. Pearl is an old girl so is looking for a calm, quiet loving home to spend the rest of her years. Pearl loves to curl up under a blanket to keep warm after a nice walk with lots of sniffing. She is still eager to go for a walk and does also enjoy a good run around our enclosed compound area when she has the chance. She loves a boomer ball! Pearl is very food motivated which is a bonus for getting to know her. Pearl would be best suited to a home that has owned a Frenchie before. Due to her older age she does have a few health issues that can be discussed further if you are successful.

We think that Pearl would be best suited to an adult only home.

Pearl has interacted well with dogs whilst in our care, so she can potentially be rehomed with another dog- subject to a successful meet. This dog will need to be of a similar size and a calm  temperament.

name: Mavis
description:
Mavis came into our care as a stray so we don’t have any history on her. She is a typical Frenchie that likes her own way, especially around new people. She is quite protective of her kennel so will shout at you if you come near her. Out on a walk she is much more confident and can be handled. She is just a cheeky girl! She does like attention and a fuss, on her terms, once she gets to know you. She has the potential to be a very loving companion, she just needs the right home that has the patience to allow her to settle down into a new environment. She may need some basic training once she gets home as we are not sure if she has lived in a home before. Mavis needs an experienced home, either with the breed or with nervous rescue dogs.

Mavis needs to be in an adult only home, no visiting children.

Mavis has socialised well with dogs whilst in our care but we believe she would be best suited to being the only dog in the home.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Dean
description:
Dean is a very friendly boy, he likes to say hello to everyone he meets and loves a fuss. He was a little nervous when he first came in though, it has taken some time for him to reach this point. He loves his toys and can play independently with them in his kennel, he has a favourite toy here which is a string of sausages! He’s a big foody and loves all kinds of tasty snacks. He also enjoys his walks around the woods taking in all of the different smells. With him being a stray there is a possibility that he’s never lived in a home before so some training might be needed to help settle him in. Experience with Frenchie’s is preferred, as they usually have cheeky personalities once they have settled.

Dean needs to be the only dog in the home. He needs continuous socialisation training around dogs to help build his confidence as he can be a little snappy and unsure of new dogs. He has little dog syndrome! His new family must be committed to taking him to training classes.

Dean is best suited to be rehomed with children who are 16 years and over – subject to a successful meet.

name: Ronnie
description:
Ronnie was very nervous and shut down when he first arrived, very unsure of everyone and didn’t know who he could trust. With time and patients from staff, Ronnie is now a completely different dog. He is a super happy boy, who absolutely loves everyone he meets. As soon as he sees you he’s instantly wiggly and gets all giddy. Ronnie brings a smile to everyone’s face with his amazing personality.

With Ronnie having lots of energy and being super playful, he is looking for an active home. His new home must be an adult only home, due to how nervous he was initial here at the home.

We don’t believe Ronnie would be suitable to live with cats or small animals.

Whilst in our care, Ronnie has socialised really well with other dogs. Therefore, we believe he could potentially live with another dog of a similar temperament and able to deal with his craziness – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Wayne
description:
Wayne will do anything for a good cuddle, he is a super affectionate boy who loves all the attention. He is very giddy and gets very excited when he sees you and even more excited when it’s time for his walk. Wayne can jump up with excitement, so would benefit from further training with this. As he is still a young boy, he is looking for an active home able to give him the exercise he requires.

Since being in our care, Wayne has socialised well with other dogs and enjoys their company whilst out on walks. Therefore, we do believe he could potentially live with another dog of a similar temperament and able to keep up with his craziness – subject to a successful meet.

We don’t have any previous history on Wayne as he sadly came into our care as a stray. We believe he could potentially live with children no younger than 14 years old – subject to a successful meet.

Wayne wouldn’t be suitable to live with cats or small animals.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Rambo
description:
Meet Rambo!  He is a gorgeous boy with a heart full of love.  Rambo is a very sweet affectionate lad who loves spending time outside and enjoying the world around him.  He has so much to offer the right family and is looking for a home where he can truly thrive.  Kennel life is incredibly stressful for Rambo.  He struggles with being confined, often scratching and climbing the bars when he becomes overwhelmed.  However, once he is out of his kennel, he relaxes enjoys his surroundings and is a very happy boy with his tail wagging like mad.  Being returned to his kennel is particularly difficult for him, so he would benefit hugely from a home where he can feel safe, settled and secure.  Rambo loves  – long walks getting out and about, off-lead time in our secure compound where he can chase around with his toys, being brushed and enjoying a little pampering and spending time with people receiving lots of fuss and strokes.  Rambo walks nicely on the lead, making him  a lovely companion for someone who enjoys getting outdoors.  As a Husky, he would need an active lifestyle filled with long walks, hikes, adventures and plenty of opportunities to explore.  Rambo is looking for an active, loving home that understands his needs and can offer him time, exercise and the companionship he deserves.  He will need a private secure garden where he can safely enjoy some off lead time as well as an adopter that is committed to keeping him mentally and physically stimulated.  Most importantly, Rambo needs a home where he can feel relaxed and comfortable, away from the stress of kennel life.

Rambo has socialised well with other dogs while in our care, so we feel he could potentially be rehomed with another dog of similar size following a successful meet and greet.

As Rambo came into the home as a stray we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

If you have a holiday in the next 3 months, please wait until you reply to apply for a dog.

name: Wolfie
description:
Wolfie is an ex racer who has spent his life in kennels. He is now in need of a loving comfortable home to call his own. As he has never lived in a home before he will need a family that is willing to put in the training needed to get him comfortable in a new environment. He is a friendly boy who doesn’t mind a fuss but can be a little more independent. He is a chilled boy who enjoys spending time snoozing on his bed. He can get excited when he gets to play with toys.

We think that Wolfie could potentially be rehomed with children who are 12 years and over.

Wolfie could potentially be rehomed with another dog of a similar size and calm temperament – subject to a successful meet.

No cats or small furries for Wolfie due to being an ex racer.

name: Tommy
description:
Tommy is an ex racing greyhound who has spent his life in kennels. He is now looking for a comfortable and loving home to call his own. He will need a family that is happy to introduce and train him around everything that is involved in living in a home environment. Tommy is a very affectionate boy and has been described as a velcro dog by the kennel staff. He is after a home where he can get plenty of attention and cuddles throughout the day. He is a big foodie and is motivated by treats, which is a bonus to help with training.

Tommy is confident around staff and volunteers but due to his size we believe that he would be best suited to an adult only home.

Tommy is a little unsure around most dogs so will need further positive training to help build up his confidence in this area. He is currently paired with another greyhound in the kennel and has has no issues with her, so we believe that he could be rehomed with another calm greyhound or sighthound – subject to a successful meet.

No cats or small furries for Tommy due to his racing background.

name: Amanda
description:
Amanda came into our care as a stray so we don’t have any background information on her. She was a little unsure and nervous when she first arrived but has slowly started to come out of her shell. She can be affectionate once she knows you. She is a typical cheeky Frenchie who likes to have her own way. She is looking for a home with a family that has previous experience or knowledge of the breed and is happy to work with her until she is more settled. We believe that Amanda may need some basic training to help her improve her manners in the home.

Amanda has socialised well with dogs whilst in our care but we feel that she would be best suited to the only dog in the home.

We feel that Amanda would be best suited for an adult only home, no visiting children.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Rafi
description:
Rafi is a lively, happy boy with a cheeky personality. Rafi is still just a young boy who is in need of a stable and loving home. He is after a family that is happy to put in a lot of time and effort into his training to help him improve his manners. Dobermans are a breed that need to be worked with for their entire life so we are after someone who is fully committed to taking on this responsibility. Experience with this breed or similar is also a must.

Rafi is going to need a large fully enclosed garden that he can have off lead time in, to burn off energy and to help with his training. Rafi will need plenty of walks and mental stimulation to keep him occupied so he doesn’t cause too much mischief. Rafi would benefit from a home where someone is around a lot and has plenty of free time to focus on him and his training.

Rafi is best suited to an adult only home, with no visiting children.

Rafi needs to be the only dog in the home, no visiting dogs either. Rafi is currently under going socialisation training with dogs to help improve his reactivity. This is something that will need to be continued when he goes home and into the future.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Todd
description:
This handsome boy is Todd!  Todd is a sweet, friendly and very lively boy with plenty of energy to spare!  He is a typical hound in many ways – full of enthusiasm, curious about the world around him and always ready for his next adventure.  He absolutely loves his off-lead time in our secure compound where he can stretch his legs, explore, have a sniff and have fun with his favourite toys.  Watching Todd enjoy himself is a real pleasure! As you would expect from a Fox Hound, Todd is high-energy and needs a very active home that can provide him with plenty of daily exercise.  Walks alone may not be enough to keep his body and mind satisfied, so he would really benefit from additional activities such as scent work, tracking games, enrichment and other opportunities to use his wonderful Hound brain.  Todd is also a vocal boy – hounds are known for their voices, and Todd is certainly not shy about using his!  His new family will need to appreciate that hound singing, baying and general commentary are part of the package.  Hounds are also known for being escape artists so he will need secure, hound-proof fencing and careful management, particularly when he is outdoors. A home that understands the determination and curiosity of a scent-driven hound would be ideal.  Todd has so much character and has all the makings of a fantastic companion in the right home.  He needs someone who understands that a Fox Hound is a lifestyle, not just a pet – but for the right home, Todd will bring plenty of fun, affection and adventure.

Todd has socialised well with other dogs whilst in our care and is very playful and full-on.  We do feel he could potentially live with another dog of similar energy levels that would tolerate his play style following a successful meet and greet.

As Todd came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Shadow
description:
Shadow is a very affectionate boy who has been super friendly to our staff and volunteers since he came in to our care. With him being an ex racer, he does have a high prey drive so can try to chase squirrels whilst out for his walks! He absolutely loves chasing his toys around our secure compound.  He is a really affectionate boy who loves lots of fuss and attention.

Shadow will have spent most of his life in kennels with his racing background, so he may feel a little nervous going in to a home environment. We also do not know if he is house trained or toilet trained due to this. He loves to lie in his comfy beds after his walks – we sometimes catch him upside down showing his belly off!

Shadow has now been in our care for 237 days and is desperately searching for his forever home.

We think Shadow would prefer to be the only dog in the home as he can sometimes be a little unsure around them and isn’t too interested in interacting with them.

He could also potentially live with children 14+ years  – subject to a successful meet.

Shadow would love a home where he could relax and enjoy his retirement years and rest on a comfy bed (or couch) of his own!

name: Prince
description:
Prince came into our care as a stray so we don’t have much history on him. We do believe that he could have potentially lived in a home previously and that he isn’t from a racing background. Prince is a happy excitable boy that jumps up in the kennel when you go into him. He can get very giddy for his walks and loves to be outside taking in all of the different smells. Prince has enjoyed different kinds of enrichment in between his walks and loves playing with his toys. He is a sweet boy who is after a loving forever home.

Prince has been rehomed recently but showed signs of  having separation anxiety so he is in need of a home where someone is around most of the time and is able to build up his time being left. Experience with sight hounds or rescue dogs will be beneficial to ensure that he is getting the training that he needs to settle into a new home.

Prince would be best suited to a home with children who are 16 years and over due to his bouncy nature – subject to a successful meet.

Prince initially could be vocal around dogs due to being a little unsure, we have now found out this is due to him wanting to say hello. He has been on group walks recently and loved interacting with other dogs and saying hello. He can be very enthusiastic when meeting dogs so we need someone that is able to physically hold onto him so he can continue on with his socialisation  training and learn better manners around dogs. We still think it would be best for him to be the only dog in the home so he can be the main focus.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Simea
description:
She was born on site, along with her siblings who have now been rehomed, when her Mum sadly came into our care pregnant as a stray.

We are looking for experienced adult only home, who have owned Malinois or Shepherds before. She isn’t going to be a dog that is interested in working but she is still going to need a very active home with someone who is looking to train her to work in sports or something similar.

New owners must be willing to take to puppy classes and continue socialising, as this is vital for this particular breed. She will need constant mental as well as physical stimulation, her new family must be willing to provide this.

She may potentially live with another dog, it will need to be a neutered male of a similar temperament and willing to put up with a young pup – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Hero
description:
Hero is an ex racing greyhound who is now looking for his forever home with a family that can help him settle into life beyond the kennels. He is a confident, lively boy with plenty of personality. He gets very excited when it’s time for a walk and can jump around on the lead, so will need someone who is comfortable handling a tall strong greyhound. With a little training and consistency this is something that can be worked on. Although he is confident in many ways, he does need help building his confidence when it comes to being touched and handled as he can get a little worried.  Hero deserves the chance to learn, grow and discover just how good life can be outside of kennels.

Hero can be rehomed with mature children who are 16 years and over, due to his size and bouncy nature. This will be subject to a successful meet.

Hero is currently paired with another greyhound and has interreacted well with dogs whilst in our care, so we believe that he would be rehomed with another dog- subject to a successful meet and greet.

name: Bear
description:
Bear is a very nervous boy when he meets new people for the first time. It takes a little while for him to come around but with patience and yummy treats he slowly starts to trust you. Once he has gained your trust and is comfortable he is an affectionate boy and loves to give out kisses. He will need to have multiple regular meets before going home.

Bear is a big dog who doesn’t understand his size, he is constantly jumping up for cuddles and doesn’t know what personal space is. Bear is going to require a lot of training to help him learn manners. He can be a very cheeky boy at times! He will need socialising in different environments and around people to help him build his confidence up. Bear gets super excited when going for walks and is very strong on the lead, this is another area that will need more training. Bear loves playing with his toys, splashing around in water and zooming around our enclosed area.

Bear is looking for an adult only home that has previous experience with big boisterous dogs. It would be beneficial of his new home to have either knowledge or experience of his breed also. No regular visiting children either please. He is going to need a very active home with a family that is able to provide him with plenty of exercise and mental stimulation to keep him busy. As he is still only a young dog he can get up to mischief when he is bored. Bear’s new family need to be committed to putting in the training that he needs not only initially but keeping it up for the rest of his life.

Bear needs to be the only dog in the home so that he can have all of attention to help get him settled. Bear can interact well with dogs whilst out on walks but will need further training to help improve this.

We know that Bear is going to require a lot of work at first but once he is trained he will make a lovely family dog who will love going on plenty of adventures. Taking on a dog this size is a big commitment, please ensure that you are serious and have thought about the future before applying.

name: Ripley
description:
Meet Ripley!! He is a gorgeous boy looking for an active, committed home where he can continue to learn and thrive.  He’s a friendly, affectionate boy with a fun-loving personality and is always ready for a game with his favourite toys.  He is full of energy and loves to play, so he will need an active family who can provide plenty of exercise, enrichment, and ongoing training.  Like many young dogs, he can become a little mouthy and nippy when he’s excited, so he will benefit from patient guidance and positive reinforcement to help him learn appropriate manners.  He is still working on his basic commands and will need someone willing to continue his training.  He can also occasionally rag his lead, so further lead training will be important.  Previous experience with Shar-pei’s would be a real advantage, as they can have their own unique characteristics and training needs.   If you’re looking for a playful, lively young dog and have to time and commitment to help him become the wonderful companion we know he can be, Ripley could be the boy for you.

Ripley has socialised well with other dogs and is very playful with them.  He can sometimes get frustrated and bark if he can’t get to them straight away.  We do feel he would be best rehomed as the only dog where he can continue to learn appropriate ways to interact with other dogs.

As Ripley came into the home as a stray we have no previous history on him and as he can be a little nippy when over-excited we would like any children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Star
description:
Star is a typical Patterdale Terrier who is always raring to go! She loves being outdoors, exploring new smells and trying to chase any wildlife she comes across. Star would love a fully enclosed garden where she can enjoy plenty of secure off-lead time and burn off some of her energy. Patterdale experience is essential as she can have her cheeky moments and will need a family who understands her spirited nature. Star has been rehomed twice previously so is looking for a patient family that has a lot of experience with dogs that need extra training and time to settle into a new life in a home.

We have found that Star struggles when left alone, so her new family will need to be around for most of the time. She will need someone who has the time, patience and commitment to help her settle into her new life and feel comfortable in a home environment. As Star was found as a stray, we don’t have much background information about her. However, we know she is an energetic, characterful girl who will thrive with the right family, plenty of exercise and lots of love.

Star may require multiple meets so she can get to know her new family before going home. Her new family will need to be patient and understanding whilst she is settling in and getting used to her new surroundings.

We think that it is best for Star to be rehomed to an adult only home with no visiting children.

Star can be very vocal around dogs and get overwhelmed easily so will need to be the only dog in the home. She will need continuous training to help her improve her confidence.

We wouldn’t recommend Star to be rehomed with cats due to her breed.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3  months.

name: Nibbles
description:
Nibbles is a young boy who is full of energy and mischief! Nibbles loves being off lead in our enclosed area running around chasing tennis balls. He has a lot of energy so will need a very active home with a family who can take him out on lots of adventures to burn off his energy. He would benefit from mental stimulation in between walks to keep his brain stimulated. Due to being a young dog Nibbles will need a lot of further training to help him grow up to be a well mannered boy.

He can be a little nippy at times due to over excitement so he needs a family that is willing to put up with this whilst he is learning to calm down in a home environment. Nibbles has found leaving kennels and going into home life to be challenging and has therefore been returned twice. Please consider all of the challenges that come with taking on a young dog that has been in kennels for most of his life before applying. With a lot of work Nibbles will be a great companion but it will take a lot of hard work and patience to get there, he is not going to be an easy dog.

Nibbles came into our care as a stray so we don’t have any history on him. Due to being very  friendly we think that he can be rehomed with dog savvy children who are 16 years and older – subject to a successful meet.

Nibbles is friendly with every dog he meets and always wants to play but doesn’t have any manners so can be very over the top. He can potentially be rehomed with another dog that can tolerate his high energy and playfulness – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Elias
description:
Elias is a very sweet and friendly boy. He came into our care as a stray so we don’t have any background information on him. He has always been friendly with staff and volunteers whilst here. Elias can be a little strong on the lead due to his size so some basic lead training would be beneficial for him. We are looking for an active home for Elias as he has a lot of energy and would enjoy going on lots of adventures. Elias is a calm boy in his kennel and loves to have some down time with a tasty chew.

Elias is a friendly boy but due to his size we believe that it would be best for him to be rehomed with children over 14 years and over – Subject to a successful meet.

Elias needs a little more training around dogs since his castration as he has become a little unsure, therefore we believe that Elias would benefit from being the only dog in the home as he would prefer all the attention on him.

name: Ronnie
description:
Ronnie is a cheeky girl who is looking for a caring forever home. She is a bouncy girl that is full of energy and would love to go out for lots of adventures. She constantly wants to be out on walks and tries her hardest to escape from the kennel when the door is open- she’s a cheeky monkey! She is super friendly with everyone she meets and enjoys shouting at you if you try to ignore her- she constantly wants attention. Ronnie has shown signs of separation anxiety so is looking for an experienced home that has dealt with this previously. Ronnie is a typical Frenchie so she is in need of a home that has owned Frenchie’s previously.

She is a friendly girl but can get a little jealous when the attention isn’t on her, so we believe it would be best for her to be in an adult only home with no visiting children. Ronnie would be best suited to a quiet home with not many visitors.

Ronnie has socialised well with other dogs whilst in our care, however, we believe she would be best suited to a home where she can be the only dog, so she can have all the attention and love. She may need on going socialisation training around dogs due to her being in the kennels for so long.

name: Sam
description:
Sam is a very loveable boy who just wants to give out hugs to everyone he meets, he does sometimes forget how big he is though. He’s a big hit with volunteers here and they all love taking him out for his walks as they get to have lots of cuddles. He can be strong on the lead though due to his size. He’s a very sweet boy who has a big heart and is looking for someone to show him lots of love! Sam has enjoyed his walks around the woods, watching the ducks and wildlife around him. Sam would appreciate an enclosed garden that he can spend his time in relaxing and enjoying the sun. Sam loves his treats, nothing is too big or small for him – he isn’t fussy!

Sam is super friendly with everyone he meets but due to his giddy jumpy nature we believe that it would be best to rehome Sam with children over the age of 16 – subject to a successful meet and greet.

Sam needs to be the only dog in the home, he can be vocal around dogs so needs a family that has experience to help build his confidence and manners.

If you think that you could provide a comfortable home with lots of treats for Sam please apply now!

name: Florence
description:
Florence is super friendly and loves everyone that she meets! She likes to leave her mark on you in the form of drool! She absolutely loves her food and isn’t fussy at all – she will eat anything. She has recently been on a diet and her new home must be willing to continue this to help her reach her ideal weight. When you go to see her in the kennel, she is so wriggly and happy and just wants love and affection all the time. She will jump up at you to give kisses and doesn’t realise what a big chunk she is! Florence needs a home that can provide her with short walks throughout the day to help with her weight loss. Florence needs a fully enclosed private garden that she can use in between her walks, she wouldn’t be suitable to live in a flat.

Florence is looking for a adult only home. She would prefer a home where someone is around for most of the day so she can have lots of cuddles.

Florence can be a little unsure around other dogs. We have been working on socialisation with her to get her used to other dogs but this is something her new family will need to keep up so she can build her confidence. Due to this, she would be most comfortable being the only dog in the home.

name: Bess
description:
Bess is a six year old medium sized female crossbreed looking for an active home. Sadly her owner passed away and she’s not getting on with one of the other dogs she’s now living with.

She is great with children 2 upwards and we would happily rehome her with children of that age. She is a no to cats/small furries and initially at least would be better suited as an only dog. When she was assessed yesterday she was a delight- happy for cuddles and fuss, quickly making friends.

She’s a lively, energetic dog who certainly behaves much younger than 6!

She is fine out and about walking past other dogs and would make an ideal companion for someone who is active and wants a walking buddy. She does pull a bit on the lead but we’d expect that to improve when she’s getting more exercise.

She’s not keen on travelling in the car but can cope with it when necessary.

She is looking for a home with experience of dogs as she does draw confidence from her handler and can be a little anxious at times. She is fine to be left for a few hours at a time but has been known to empty the bin if left for longer!

She’s speyed and chipped but her vaccinations have lapsed (these will be done as part of the adoption process). Forever homes can be anywhere within the UK but you will need to travel to meet her in South Yorkshire.

As always we require everyone in the family and any children who are regularly going to be in contact with the dog to attend the meet.

Our usual process is that you will need to come and meet the dog and that adoption is then done on a second meet.

For some dogs additional meets may be required and potential adopters will be required to travel to the dogs location for all meets.

If you are suited we will then arrange a homecheck, vet reference and meet with the dog.

We only rehome where all resident and previous animals are/were regularly vaccinated and neutered/speyed unless on veterinary advice. All of our dogs have rescue back up.

name: Goran
description:
Gorgeous Goran is a sweet boy who bonds deeply. It really doesn’t take long to make friends with him and once he knows you, you will have a companion for life.

He’s super affectionate and loves cuddles and belly rubs!

He is a medium sized dog, just the right size to share a sofa with. Goran will happily Netflix and chill with you as often as you like.

You can also leave him on his own for reasonable periods, and he is clean in the home and knows only to play with his toys.

Goran is a sensitive soul who can be worried by strangers and unknown dogs so we are looking for an experienced owner to gently build his confidence. Em has been taking him on walks to the park and he has done so well.

Goran could live with cats but would like to be the only dog.

He will be happiest in a quiet, adult only home. He is fine sharing his love between two people.

name: Heidi
description:
Heidi, a 5 year old female Schipperke Cross, can be a worried girl initially but it does not take her long to make friends and once she knows you she is such an affectionate little girl.

She will give you the most wonderful welcome, cuddling into you and rolling onto her back for tummy rubs.

In the home Heidi is clean and non-destructive and can be left alone for a couple of hours. She enjoys her walks and going on adventures. She will make the most loyal, devoted companion.

Heidi can be anxious at times and would benefit from an experienced owner.

She will need a one person household as she can be protective of her owner and guard them from others in the home.

A quiet, adult only home would suit her best without many visitors and no visiting children.

Heidi mixes well with other dogs but prefers her own space so we are looking for a home where she can be the only dog, she cannot live with cats.

name: Elton
description:
Elton is a fantastic 8 year old male Cross-Breed dog, who is extremely affectionate and loving.It does take some time to earn his trust, but he’s very food motivated so after a few sensible introductions he will accept you as his best friend.

Once Elton knows you he is incredibly loyal and will give you the most amazing welcome!

He is a playful, entertaining boy who really thrives off human company.

He will sit and give you ‘paws up’ and loves nothing more than playing with toys.

Walks are also another firm favourite of his.

Elton is selective with other dogs, although he has a group of friends here that he lives with he can display reactivity to some, particularly if he is on a lead as he feels trapped and panics.

We are working hard to help him cope with this but believe he will make the most progress in a calm environment with an experienced owner. Elton mixes better with female dogs and may be able to live with a compatible dog but he cannot live with cats.

He is a bright boy who is keen to learn and muzzle trained, so steps can be put in place to keep him safe during training.

We are looking for a home with experience with handling reactive dogs.

Elton will require an adult only home and care will need to be taken with visitors, a calm and quiet environment is essential.

We all adore Elton here and know he has so much potential in the right home which we are so desperate to find for him.

Short/long term foster homes will also be considered.

name: Ozzy
description:
Ozzy is a fantastic dog who is goofy, lovable, playful and loyal.

His favourite things are toys and cuddles – he’s also a real water baby!

Ozzy is a sensitive soul who can be nervous around new people so needs a gentle approach but as soon as he has spent some time figuring you out he will be your best friend and will give you his whole heart once he trusts you.

He is a bright boy who loves food which makes a great tool for training and providing enrichment. He’s very clever, knows exactly what you expect of him and is eager to please. He’s a real happy go lucky boy who is affectionate and loving.

We are looking for an experienced owner for Ozzy, he needs a safe and comfortable home with minimal visitors in a quiet environment. He is crate and muzzled trained which makes it easy to manage him if visitors do need to come to the home.

We would like to find Ozzy an adult only home, ideally with another confident dog who he can learn from as he loves to run and play with other dogs but he has requested a cat free home!

Ozzy needs someone who has the patience and is willing to put in the time to build up on his impulse control. He is easily excitable so needs to learn some boundaries but he’s really good at this. He’s a young boy with so much potential and will be a great dog for the right person.

name: Axel
description:
Axel is a 3 year old male Mastiff in need of a new home due to a change in circumstances and his family feel they can no longer meet his needs (any negative comments about this will be deleted).

Axel currently lives with children who he has lived with since being a puppy but due to him not being socialised with people or other dogs for quite some time he has begun reacting to strangers so we feel a calm, sensible, experienced adult only home would be best for him.

We are confident that with time and sensible introductions he would be happy around children as he’s very loving and playful with the ones he knows and trusts. He also needs to be an only pet for now, but again this is something that could change in time.

Axel travels well in the car, is great at the vets, and loves a run around a field with his ball. We are going to spend some more time with Axel to get to know him better and hope we can find the perfect home for this handsome boy.

He is vaccinated and chipped, and his neutering will be discussed with our vet. Forever homes can be anywhere within the UK but you will need to travel to where he is in South Yorkshire. As always we require everyone in the family and any children who are regularly going to be in contact with the dog to attend the meet.

Our usual process is that you will need to come and meet the dog and that adoption is then done on a second meet. For some dogs additional meets may be required and potential adopters will be required to travel to the dogs location for all meets.

If you are suited we will then arrange a homecheck, vet reference and meet with the dog. We only rehome where all resident and previous animals are/were regularly vaccinated and neutered/speyed unless on veterinary advice. All of our dogs have rescue back up.

name: Pablo
description:
Pablo is a 3-year-old male Cross-Breed. He is a medium-to-large-sized dog who has made incredible progress since arriving in care. Initially, Pablo was a confused adolescent who struggled with communication, often becoming frustrated and overstimulated. This would lead to him jumping up and mouthing, which, given his size, could be overwhelming. Unfortunately, this behaviour resulted in him making a mistake in his previous home.

With dedicated training and patience, Pablo has transformed into a well-mannered and much more settled dog. His love for food and toys has been an excellent aid in his training, helping him learn positive behaviours. He is now a lovable rogue with so much potential for the right person. However, he still needs an experienced owner who understands bull breeds and can continue his training.

Pablo thrives in a calm and structured environment with clear boundaries and regular stimulation. He will need an adult-only home that is quiet and free from frequent visitors or young children, as a peaceful setting works best for him. His new owner must be patient and committed to providing the guidance he requires.

Although Pablo enjoys the company of other dogs and loves to play, he would be best suited as the only pet in his new home. He cannot live with cats. His adoption fee is £250.

name: Rolo
description:
Rolo is a 2-year-old male Cross-Breed. He is a medium-sized dog with a sweet and affectionate nature, though he takes time to build trust.

Once comfortable, he greets his favourite people with enthusiasm, wagging his tail and showering them with kisses. He loves being stroked and will happily roll over for tummy rubs.

Rolo is particularly wary of men and has shown reactive behaviour towards them. For this reason, a female-only home would be the best fit for him. He is currently thriving in foster, where he enjoys home comforts, zooming around in excitement before settling down for a cosy nap on the sofa.

He loves the company of other dogs and would benefit from living with a confident canine companion to help guide him. He has also passed his cat test with ease, so he could happily live with a cat in his new home.

Rolo is an insecure boy who needs an experienced owner to help him build confidence. He is intelligent and eager to learn, but he requires a quiet, adult-only home with slow, careful introductions to visitors.

He also struggles with separation anxiety, so a home with someone around most of the day is essential. He has been making good progress in foster, and with patience, he will continue to improve.

name: Glen
description:
Loyal Glen is a twelve year old male Collie Cross, currently in a Romanian private shelter and available for adoption or foster.

His dream is to be in a warm UK loving home for the winter, as the harsh Romanian winter will be very hard for an old boy like him.

Glen would thrive in a calm, stable home with confident owners who can be his rock. Once he bonds, he is faithful, loving, and will be your best friend.

Glen is still active for his age, but he would also be just as happy to sit and chill indoors with his new family.

As an only dog or with a calm female dog companion

Secure home where he can relax and feel safe

Neutered, vaccinated & health checkedLifetime RBU (Rescue Backup) from Pennypaws RescueHomecheck required

Could you be the one to give Glen his forever place?

This gorgeous boy is ready to be someone’s friend.

name: Galaxy
description:
Galaxy is a 3 year old female Cross-Breed, medium in build but tall in height with her long elegant legs. Some dogs carry an aura you cannot walk past, and in a cage crowded with six dogs, Galaxy was the one who stopped us.

She was painfully thin, her leg hurt, her whole body trembling — and yet, she glowed. There was something fragile and luminous about her, as if she were already named.

She had been left behind with no chance. But fate changed, and she was freed. Now she is safe, and her true nature blooms. Her eyes hold depth — sorrow, gratitude, and a love that overwhelms.

When she runs out onto the grass, she gallops straight toward you, only to roll over and offer her belly for rubs, her absolute favorite. And when she rests her head against you, it feels like a gift of trust you will never want to lose.

Galaxy has a gentle talent: she soothes the insecure. She bonds with frightened dogs, calming them with her presence. She is wonderful with children, playful yet tender, tall but sleek — a young soul full of promise.

Fully VaccinatedSpayed4D TestedBrucellosis TestedMicrochippedFull RBU

And here she is now — no longer trembling, no longer waiting in the dark. Galaxy runs, smiles, leans in, and asks only for love. She once begged for her life through the bars.

Today, she is ready to give her whole life to someone who chooses her. Perhaps she is waiting for you?

name: Bella
description:
Bella is a 3 year old female Cross-Breed.

She is reactive with new visitors, but she does calm down however is generally quite nervous. She has growled but never bitten. Using a safe space when people enter the home will work well for her.

She does not show any reactivity over food or toys. Once Bella is comfortable with people she is very happy, although a generally quieter home with fewer visitors would be best.

She isn’t reactive or bothered by traffic, or bikes or anything like that. Bella travels well in the car.

Bella currently struggles to be alone, being left for up to an hour but can bark and jump up at the window. She can be distressed upon someone coming home and will need someone who is around much of the time.

Bella is quiet at night, sleeps in her bed in the living room. Comes to wake me when she needs to go out, which is only once a night now. Usually around 7am.

Bella is an affectionate love bug, she is very intelligent, quick and eager to learn. Loves her walks, sniffs her way around everywhere including the house and garden. Started playing with soft toys but got bored of them quickly.

Has quickly figured out a puzzle tray containing treats and enjoys any interactive toys. Loves her licky mat and Kong. Lets you know when she wants to go ‘peepee’ by going to the door and scratching, if you don’t notice she will give a little woof or a tap.

Off the lead in the garden she does zoomies, is fast and has a terrific jump, would be great at something like dog agility.

She is very reactive when anyone approaches my house or next door, barks frantically. Bella has improved over her time in fostering a lot and will need continued work to help her settle.

he has attended training classes and done really well with the training and become friendly with some of the dogs there. She lacks confidence and likes reassurance. She is very nosey and will look out the window for hours. She is a special girl that is very loving when she knows you.

name: Patch
description:
Patch is a 2 year old male Small/Medium Cross-Breed. He is a nervous boy to begin with and can sometimes give out a growl, though this is not aggression but fear.

With a soft approach, plenty of treats, and reassurance, Patch soon begins to trust and show his true gentle nature. A safe space in the home where he can feel comfortable will help him settle in.

Despite his initial nerves, Patch is toilet trained, crate trained, and can be left for up to four hours without issue. He sleeps peacefully overnight on his bed downstairs and has shown no destructive habits.

With patience and kindness, he reveals himself to be a very loving and rewarding companion.

Patch is still learning to feel comfortable on the lead and needs continued training with this. When out walking, he can be jumpy and will sometimes hide behind his person if something unsettles him, needing reassurance to carry on.

Walking alongside another dog helps him feel more confident, and this is why he would benefit from a home with a canine companion.

His foster describes him as a nervous boy with a huge love for food, especially cheese. He spends much of his day napping and continues to improve with training every day.

With the right family, Patch will blossom into the loving, loyal, and happy dog he is meant to be.

name: Honey
description:
Honey is a 5 year old female Medium/Large Cross-Breed. She is already toilet trained and crate trained, which makes life easier for her future family.

She travels well in the car and has no destructive habits, showing she is a well-mannered and adaptable dog.

Although she can initially worry when left alone at night, Honey does settle down and learns to feel comfortable. On walks, she is mostly well behaved but can be a little strong on the lead at times.

She loves going out and about, especially in quieter places, where she feels most relaxed and happy.

Honey can be a little nervous in busy areas, so a calm environment would suit her best. She is far more comfortable with women and would like a female primary carer.

For men in the household, she simply needs a bit of extra time and patience to come round and feel at ease.

She would thrive in a home with another dog, as canine companionship helps her confidence and makes her feel secure. Honey is able to live with cats, which adds to her versatility.

She is also suitable for a home with children over the age of ten, making her a wonderful family companion.

name: Pickle
description:
Pickle is a four year old male Cross-Breed of medium to large size who is highly intelligent, full of energy, and loves both cuddles and playtime.

Pickles hasn’t experienced loads of new people in the home, when there are people such as work men, Pickle has a woof at the door, and then is redirected to his safe space and he goes in there brilliantly.

Although Pickle is nervous and can be reactive towards strangers, he adores people once he gets to know them. He has not bitten nor growled at anyone but he does enjoy a quieter home.

He is described as a very happy boy around people he trusts and is excited when they return to see him, once he knows someone he does not bark.

On walks Pickle wears a collar, harness and lead, he is also muzzle trained for his safety as well as people out and about. This beautiful boy walks well on the lead, he is currently learning to heel and is making good progress with this.

He can be strong for the first 10–20 minutes and then he calms down and is a pleasure to walk.

Pickle is good with other dogs and could share his home with them pending a successful meet and slow and sensible introductions. He can become over-stimulated at times and does need to learn manners and socialisation.

Pickle has previously lived with younger children and struggled with this, therefore, he is looking for an adult only home or with older dog-savvy children that will respect his boundaries, around 16 years plus.

Pickle does show prey drive and therefore cannot share a home with cats or small furries. Pickle is toilet trained and crate trained, he can currently be left alone for up to 4 hours with no issues and sleeps well overnight.

Pickle is a wonderful dog – highly intelligent and full of energy. However, he doesn’t require massive walks or runs, he just as much enjoys chilling with you at home. I think he’d enjoy some sort of agility or scent training for mental stimulation.

His favourite things are squeaky balls and sand pits. He loves a good pamper and will stand for ages for a groom and lets me clip his nails. He loves a good cuddle and will head bop you to get one.

Whilst he does have his quirks there are easy ways around them and as long as time and patience is given to him he will make a fantastic companion.

name: Coley
description:
Coley is a 3year male cross breed located in Spain.

This handsome regal looking young boy is Coley, and he arrived at the pound just as it was losing its Lorca contract but he was one of the lucky dogs they held back in private kennels to stop him going to the kill shelter, where the contract was transferring.

Coley is a medium sized boy with a short tan coat and a black masked face.

He is a bit of a Heinz 57 and he is doing really well at the emergency private kennels. He goes out every day walking with a female dog and can see male dogs the other side of the fence with no signs of aggression.

He is very friendly with people and he likes to get fuss. He does have a lot of energy and will just run around on his own, but on his walks he is very good and walks well. Coley is good around dog savvy children.

Keen to learn and knows some commands already, loves attention and good with female dogs

Living with dogs : Yes to females not sure males

name: Prince
description:
Prince is a 5-year-old male Labrador Cross. He is a medium to large dog with long legs and a short coat, giving him a striking, athletic appearance.

Prince has spent the last four years in the care of 2nd Chance Dogs in Cyprus, patiently waiting for his forever home.

His story began when he grew too big for his previous owner, who would leave him locked on a balcony for long hours each day. Eventually, they made the decision to surrender him to the rescue.

Despite his rough start, Prince remains a fun, bouncy boy who thrives on playtime and staying active for as long as possible.

After such a long time in rescue, Prince would benefit from an understanding adopter who can help him transition back into a home environment.

He has a playful side but also potential to enjoy quieter, more relaxed moments once he feels secure. Prince enjoys meeting new people and has a strong desire for attention, which is why he prefers to be the only dog in the home.

He is intelligent, energetic, and perfectly suited for an active household willing to channel his energy into positive activities.

With the lifetime support offered by 2nd Chance Dogs and guidance from an experienced UK Behaviourist, Prince’s new family will have all the help they need to help him settle and thrive.

name: Jerry
description:
Jerry – 3 year old male Cross-Breed was saved from the streets of Romania this winter.

He has been somebody’s pet but was left to roam.

He is now in a foster shelter. His foster mum says that he is a really good boy. He is friendly and walks on a lead. Jerry shares a kennel with two other dogs.

It’s such a shame that he hasn’t got a home of his own. He so deserves one.

Jerry is neutered and fully vaccinated. He has his own pet passport and is microchipped.

Jerry would suit most families with children over 7 or a couple or individual. He would love to go for walks and sniffs. He is a sociable dog.

He would be transported directly to his new adopter and we provide full rescue back up.

name: Cash
description:
Cash is a 5-year-old male Cross-Breed. He is a gentle dog who gets along well with other dogs, making him a great addition to a multi-dog household. Although he is initially shy around people, with time and patience, he warms up and builds trust.

A calm and understanding owner would be ideal to help him adjust and gain confidence.

Cash has not been tested with cats, so it is unclear how he would react to feline companions. Any potential home with cats should be prepared for slow and supervised introductions to ensure compatibility.

His friendly nature with other dogs suggests he enjoys social interactions, which could help him feel more comfortable in a new home.

He has not had any known interactions with children, so his suitability for a family with young ones is uncertain. A quieter home with adults or older children who understand his initial shyness may be the best environment for him.

Currently, Cash is in foster kennels in Romania, waiting for a family to give him the love and security he deserves. His gentle and reserved personality makes him a great candidate for a patient and understanding adopter who can help him settle into a forever home.

name: Columbo
description:
Columbo – 3 year old male Labrador Retriever

Columbo is a 3 year old male Labrador Retriever and is medium to large in size. He’s the real-deal Lab — playful, loyal, and desperately craving a home where he can finally be the star of the show.

Some dogs survive the worst, and yet somehow, they never stop loving. Columbo is one of those dogs. This beautiful 3-year-old black Labrador was trapped in a kill shelter, forced to fight for space, food, and survival.

In that cruel environment, he had an eye issue too, but he never lost his spirit.

When we saved Columbo in December 2024, so many people were moved by his story. He stole hearts without even trying—a dog who had suffered but still greeted the world with pure love and trust. Columbo visited an eye specialist, he was operated on, but he did not gain his full vision in that eye.

Columbo is a true Labrador—playful, affectionate, and full of life. He adores people and craves human touch, as if trying to make up for all the love he has missed.

He can be a bit pushy for attention, always eager to soak up affection. Because of this, he would do best as the only dog in the home, where he can finally have the love all to himself. This boy has waited too long to be someone’s dog.

He deserves a family that will cherish him, play with him, and remind him that he is safe, loved, and finally home.

Fully vaccinatedNeutered4D testedBrucellosis testedHe had a cherry eye surgery and has partial eyesight due to the attack in the kill shelterMicrochipped

Columbo has fought for survival, and now he is ready to fight for love. He is ready to run, play, and finally belong. Could you be the one to give Columbo the home he has been dreaming of?

name: Prado
description:
Hello, I’m Prado, a small 6 year old kokkoni boy in foster near Oxford and I’m looking for my forever home.

A year ago, my greatest achievement was making myself small enough that nobody would notice me.

My name is Prado, and last October I was rescued with 26 other dogs from a place where none of us had really known what it meant to feel safe.

When I arrived at the shelter, I found a corner, curled myself into the smallest ball I could and tried to disappear. I was never aggresive, I was simply terrified.

I spent 11 months at the shelter, surrounded by people who were kind to me and desperately wanted me to understand that I was finally safe. But when you’ve spent your life being frightened, learning to trust doesn’t happen overnight.

Then, at the end of August, I was offered a foster home in the UK.

For the first time, I started discovering what living in a real home could be like.

I learned to enjoy my walks. I discovered how much fun it is to play with other dogs. I started watching the humans around me and realised they might actually be quite nice.

And then I did something nobody expected. I went to my foster mum and asked for a cuddle.

Now, let’s not get carried away. Cuddles are still very much on my terms. But apparently this is a huge event because everyone gets ridiculously excited whenever I ask for one.

I’ve come such a long way, but I’m still a sensitive boy and I’m looking for a special kind of family.

I need people who are patient, gentle and understanding, who won’t rush me or expect me to be confident from day one. I’ll need time to settle into a new home and learn that my new people are safe too.

And there is one thing I absolutely need:

I must live with another friendly, confident dog.

Other dogs are incredibly important to me. I learn from them, follow their lead and feel much braver when I have a doggy friend beside me. I would not be happy as an only dog.

I’m not looking for someone to change me.

I’m looking for someone who will love the Prado I am today while giving me the time and security to become the Prado I’m still discovering.

My foster family gave me something I never had before: the chance to feel safe.

Now I’m ready for the final piece. A family of my own. A home where I never have to leave again.

Maybe you’re someone who understands that sometimes the smallest steps are actually the biggest victories. Maybe you won’t mind waiting for me.

And maybe, after I’ve watched you for a while and decided you’re one of the good ones, I’ll wander over and quietly ask…

name: Maddie
description:
Maddie is a 12-year-old Springer Spaniel being fostered in Gloucestershire in an adult family home with another dog.

Sometimes, the dogs who need us most are the ones who have spent their entire lives without ever knowing what it truly means to be part of a family.

Maddie is one of those dogs, and we would love nothing more than to find her the forever home she so deserves.

Maddie first came into Starfish Dog Rescue this summer when her previous owner sadly had to move and was unable to keep all of his dogs.

An ex-working gundog, Maddie had spent her entire life living in kennels and had never experienced the comforts of living in a home.

Heartbreakingly, when her owner could no longer keep his dogs, Maddie was facing euthanasia simply because there was nowhere for her to go.

Thankfully, she came into our care, and for the first time in her life, she discovered what it was like to live in a home, enjoy family life and be loved just for being herself.

Despite never having lived indoors before, Maddie settled beautifully into her foster home. She was treated for ear infections, had her teeth cleaned and was spayed.

We also discovered that she is very hard of hearing, but this hasn’t stopped her from enjoying life. She was brilliant off the lead, keeping a close eye on her person and enjoying her walks.

Sadly, through no fault of her own, Maddie has now returned to our care. We are absolutely heartbroken for her.

After everything she has been through, we desperately want to find her a permanent home where she can finally settle and know that she belongs.

SO, LET US TELL YOU ABOUT OUR VERY LOVELY MADDIE!

Maddie is an absolute sweetheart with a wonderful temperament. And if you think a 12-year-old dog wants nothing more than a little potter around the garden before returning to bed, think again!

This lovely girl has plenty of life and character left in her. She enjoys her walks, loves meeting people and has even been out enjoying a visit to the pub.

She has been an absolute star on her outings, taking everything in her stride and showing everyone what a lovely dog she is.

She is currently sharing her foster home with a much younger dog we affectionately call Naughty Norman! Maddie has been wonderfully tolerant of him and has even enjoyed playing with him.

Like many dogs, Maddie has a few little quirks. She can be a bit grumbly if another dog disturbs her while she’s sleeping or if she has her ball.

Maddie is all noise and has never followed through — it’s her way of letting another dog know she’s not entirely impressed!

She has shown herself to be very tolerant of Naughty Norman, but we do feel she would be happiest as an only dog or sharing her home with a calm, older canine companion who will respect her boundaries.

We want Maddie’s retirement to be peaceful and happy, where she can enjoy her home comforts without having to share everything with a younger, more boisterous companion.

We would love to find Maddie a home with people who still enjoy getting out for a daily walk in the local countryside or woodland.

She doesn’t need a working life anymore, but she certainly still enjoys being out and about with her people.

Her hearing is very limited, so her family will need to be mindful of this and communicate with her in ways she can understand.

Her previous foster home found her brilliant off the lead, but any new family will need to assess this carefully in their own environment and take her hearing into account when keeping her safe.

Above all, Maddie needs people who will cherish her, give her the comfort she missed out on for so many years and understand that an older dog still has so much love and companionship to offer.

Maddie is not looking for a perfect home. She’s looking for a home where she can finally be someone’s beloved dog.

Maddie is now spayed and microchipped, has started her vaccination course, has been treated for fleas and worms, has completed her treatment for ear mites and has had a dental scale and polish.

We know some people will pass her by because she is 12. But please look beyond her age. Maddie has a lovely nature, a zest for life and so much more to give. We would love her next chapter to be the happiest one yet.

At Starfish Dog Rescue, our dogs are treated as our own. We do not home on a first-come, first-served basis, and we will take the time needed to find the right family for Maddie.

Maddie is spayed, fully vaccinated, chipped, had her teeth cleaned in the summer while in our care and wormed/fleaed.

If you feel you could offer this very special girl the loving retirement she deserves, please email starfishdogrescue@hotmail.co.uk to request our adoption questionnaire.

Please help us find Maddie her forever home. After a lifetime of living in kennels, she deserves to know what it feels like to be home for good.

This was a video of her back in the summer when she was in our care

These are the new videos with Naunghty Norman

Out on her walk with Norman she runs and acts like a much younger dog

name: Alaska
description:
Alaska is a 2 year 6 month old female Cross-Breed, a golden beauty with a personality as radiant as her smile. Rescued on February 17, 2023, she is affectionate, devoted, and happiest when she has her person all to herself.
