Alaska is a dog who loves deeply and bonds fiercely. She thrives on one-on-one attention, cuddles, and being the center of her human’s world. She isn’t just a pet—she is a best friend, a loyal companion who will love you with every part of her being.

While Alaska adores her person, she prefers a home without children or other dogs. She is protective of her space and affection and thrives best in a calm, structured environment where she doesn’t have to share the love she craves so much.

She needs someone who understands her strong, independent nature and will give her the stability she deserves.

If you’re looking for a dog who will be completely yours, who will greet you with endless joy, and who will stand by your side through everything, Alaska is the one.

Alaska isn’t looking for just any home—she’s looking for her person, the one who will love her as much as she loves them. If you’ve been searching for a loyal, affectionate, and devoted best friend who will always put you first, Alaska is waiting for you.

name: Forest
description:
Forest is a 2 to 3 year old male German Shepherd Cross.

In August, he was Dog Number 18. A big boy in a cage full of smaller girls. Always at the back. Always waiting. Never pushing his way to the front.

When we finally stepped inside, we saw who he really was. Calm. Soft. Gentle with every one of us. So we chose him.

Today he is Forest. And the boy who waited so patiently has turned out to be one of the loveliest souls we know.

He is big, but there is nothing heavy about his heart. He is happy, easy and kind. Cheerful without being wild. Obedient, steady and a joy to have around.

He lives in a group with many dogs and gets along beautifully with them, just not with dominant males. He is good with children too, but he is a big boy, so a home with older kids would suit him best.

He has never once asked for much. He just waited, quietly and patiently, while others went first. Now it’s his turn. A family to come home to. A garden to stretch out in. A person who looks at that big gentle face and says: you’re ours.

Happy, gentle, obedient and wonderfully easy-going

Good with other dogs, except dominant males

Good with children, best with older kids due to his size

He waited behind the others for so long. Please, let him be first for once.

name: Bruno
description:
BRUNO — A BRILLIANT MALINOIS BOY LOOKING FOR HIS PERFECT MATCH

Bruno is a two-and-a-half-year-old Belgian Malinois cross male.

Meet our gorgeous Bruno. A big heart, a clever mind and an endless enthusiasm for life.

Bruno is everything Malinois lovers adore about this remarkable breed. Intelligent. Energetic. Loyal. Eager to learn. Absolutely devoted to his people.

We rescued him from a killing pound in August. He was desperately thin, restless and chained up, unable to enjoy the freedom he craved. Today he is a healthy, happy, affectionate boy who has blossomed into a wonderful companion.

And what a character he is.Bruno adores people. He is loving, kind and deeply attached to those he trusts. He loves being close, following you around and making himself part of everything you do.

He is exceptionally clever and wonderfully responsive to training. He already knows basic commands, walks beautifully on the lead and has learned his house manners.

With his intelligence and eagerness to please, he would thrive with agility, continued training and activities that challenge both his mind and body.

And yes, Bruno is a jumper. He is an athletic, determined boy who loves his freedom and will find a way out of confinement. Being shut in a cage is something he simply cannot tolerate.

Bruno needs someone who understands Malinois characteristics and will appreciate everything that makes him special. Plenty of exercise, mental stimulation, space to explore, consistent guidance and, above all, a loving home where he can be a true companion.

He gets along beautifully with other dogs, although dominant males are not suitable companions. He is not cat friendly.

In the right hands, Bruno will be an extraordinary companion. A dog to learn with, explore with, laugh with and love with all your heart.

BRUNO — AT A GLANCE:Male, approximately 2.5 years oldBelgian Malinois crossExceptionally loving, loyal, affectionate and people-orientedHighly intelligent, eager to learn and responsive to commandsEnergetic, athletic, excellent potential for agilityHouse-trained and knows basic commandsWalks beautifully on the leadGood with other dogs, except dominant malesNot suitable for homes with catsNeeds an active, breed-experienced home with secure fencingDislikes confinement and is capable of jumping fences

BRUNO’S HEALTH:HealthyNeuteredFully vaccinatedBrucellosis tested4D tested

Bruno is looking for someone who will understand his wonderful Malinois nature, give him the freedom and stimulation he needs, and love him as fiercely as he will love them.

name: Columbus
description:
COLUMBUS — ALL THIS BEAUTY, WAITING FOR YOU

Columbus is a three-year-old Sarplaninac (Yugoslavian Shepherd) male.

If you have ever dreamed of sharing your life with a magnificent Sarplaninac, we would love you to meet Columbus.

Three years old. Absolutely breathtaking. A glorious coat, an enormous cuddly look and the happiest, most wonderful nature.

Columbus is beautifully relaxed with people. He enjoys their company, welcomes affection and has that calm, unhurried confidence of a dog who is perfectly comfortable being himself.

He is calm. He is content. He simply likes sharing the day with his people.

And then another dog invites him to play, and our dignified boy turns into an enormous, delighted puppy. He loves a proper game: chasing, wrestling, rolling around. He would be especially happy with a friendly, playful canine companion who enjoys a good boisterous game.

You can picture him lying peacefully in the garden, watching the world. Getting up when he hears someone coming. Walking over to greet his people. Enjoying a gentle stroke, then settling down again somewhere comfortable.

Columbus was rescued from a Serbian kill shelter. Ever since, we have wanted something very special for him. A home where his magnificent presence is welcomed. A family who learns all his little habits and looks forward to seeing that beautiful face every day.

That life could be just around the corner. Columbus is already in Northampton, ready to meet you in person.

COLUMBUS’S HEALTH:Fully vaccinatedNeutered4D tested – heartworm positiveBrucellosis testedThe full heartworm treatment is provided and covered by Ad Astra Rescue

We would love to see Columbus grow old in a home where his family knows every expression on that beautiful face, and loves him more with every passing year.

name: Harlow
description:
HARLOW — SHE CRIED FOR LOVE. NOW SHE HAS SO MUCH OF IT TO GIVE

Harlow is a two-year-old Labrador cross female.

We heard her before we saw her.A black girl at the front of her cage.Crying as we walked along the rows.Crying louder when we moved on.Pushing her paws through the wire, again and again.

We could not walk past her.Nobody could have.

Today she has a name. Harlow.And all that crying has turned into love.

Harlow is affection in its purest form.Tender in a way that stops you.She comes to you soft, with her whole body.She presses against your side and stays there.As long as you will let her.

Stroke her once and she leans closer.Stop, and she waits beside you, hoping for more.She doesn’t jump. She doesn’t push.She simply loves you.Quietly. Completely.As if that is what she was made for.

With other dogs she is just as gentle.Kind. Easy. Peaceful.

She is only two years old.A whole life is in front of her.And not one day of it has begun yet.

No one who calls her name when they come home.No one to curl up against at night.No one who knows how her eyes soften at their touch.

She is ready now.Healthy. Spayed. Fully tested.Everything has been done for her.Except the one thing she has been crying for since the day we found her.

HARLOW — AT A GLANCE:2 years old femaleMedium-sized Labrador crossExceptionally affectionate, tender, gentle and lovingWonderful with other dogs

HARLOW’S HEALTH:HealthySpayed4D testedBrucellosis tested

Harlow once cried for someone to stop.Please, be the one who stops for her.

name: Bruce
description:
Bruce is a 5-year-old male French Bulldog. He’s currently in foster care after being removed from a tough situation—his previous owner was unwell and Bruce ended up spending most of his days shut out in the garden while carers were inside.

Despite this, he’s maintained a friendly nature and still has that cheeky spark typical of the breed.

He walks really nicely on the lead and is very sociable with other dogs. In fact, he might be too sociable—he’s been a bit obsessive with the other dogs in his current foster home, to the point where one of them is now avoiding him.

Because of this, Bruce really needs a new foster or forever home where he can have more balance and calm, ideally with someone who knows the quirks of French Bulldogs and can help him channel that energy the right way.

Bruce is not yet neutered, though it’s already booked in. Any dogs in his new home would need to be neutered due to his current behaviour.

He’s not a candidate for homes with cats or children, so an adult-only, pet-savvy environment will be best for this chunky little lad.

With the right setup and some patient guidance, Bruce will thrive and bring a lot of love (and probably snorts) into someone’s life.

name: Casper
description:
Casper is a 1-year-old male Husky. He’s currently in foster care in Westbury, Wiltshire, where he’s been settling in over the past few weeks.

While his foster carers had hoped to become his forever family, it’s become clear that Casper is absolutely not cat-friendly, which has made it impossible for him to stay.

Casper came from a pretty rough background—his previous owners would leave him alone for days at a time. Naturally, that kind of neglect left some scars, but this young lad is already showing resilience.

In just a short time, he’s made real progress. He’s learned to take himself off to another room to relax and was even left alone briefly without any issue. That’s a big win for a dog with his history.

What Casper really needs now is a very calm, adult-only home with experienced owners who are home most of the day. He needs a bit of time to trust new people, but once he does, he’s incredibly affectionate, bright, and playful.

He could potentially live with a calm, spayed female dog of similar size, but he won’t tolerate another male dog in the home. With the right people and a peaceful environment, Casper’s going to be someone’s absolute ride-or-die.

name: Noche
description:
Noche came to live in the UK from Oman in October last year but there have been a lot of changes in his life since then, mainly a baby in the family, so it is in Noche’s best interest to look for a more suitable forever home for him.

Noche is a healthy 24kg, neutered, fully vaccinated (vet records available), up to date with deworming/tick/flea treatment, brucellosis tested (negative), & Microchipped dog.

Noche is an extremely loving and loyal dog. He has learned many obedience skills – from simple commands (sit, stay, break, bed, place, spin, middle etc), heel walking, recall and is threshold trained to certain doors in the house.

He is a typical rebellious teenager at the moment, trying his luck! He has medium energy levels so would love a home with a garden. He LOVES the hills and roaming in the Scottish mountains, in both sunshine and snow!

The ideal home would be rural/semi rural with owners who have the time to give to him. He is not used to children so older children only, he has had good interactions with 12+ year old dog savvy children.

He is selective with other dogs when meeting them/ being walked on the leash and is much better with other dogs when off leash.

name: Jack
description:
Jack is 4 years old and weighs just over 14kg, with lovely long legs. He is neutered and fully vaccinated. He is in foster with a dog called Marley, and they love doing zoomies, though Jack also enjoys just chilling by himself.

Jack is originally from Romainia and came to the UK as a puppy, but sadly he was badly let down by his previous family. Since being in foster he has blossomed and he now walks well on his lead and is fine around traffic.

He is enjoying many new experiences, inclusing trips to cafés and the beach. He is polite when meeting new dogs and people. Within the home he is quite happy snoozing.

We are looking for a home with a friendly, well socialised dog of a similar size, or a home with a garden where Jack can chill. He can be an only dog and can be left for several hours.

Jack travels well in the car. He also knows a number of commands such as ‘sit’ and ‘stay’.

We are looking for an adopter who is consistent in their training, using positive reinforcement, and who will introduce Jack to new experiences in a kind and supportive way.

Jack will make a super companion in the right home but because he can be nervous if things in the home get too hectic, we will not rehome him to a home with children or where children visit regularly.

Full Rescue backup and support throughout the adoprion process and for the lifetime of the dog.

name: Luna
description:
Luna is a 3 year old female Pointer Cross, large and athletic at 32 kg, and absolutely bursting with energy, love, and loyalty.

This gorgeous girl once had a home, but when her owner had to leave the country, she was left behind—confused, heartbroken, and now stuck in a shelter. It’s no place for a dog like Luna, not when she has so much life and affection to give.

Energetic and adventurous — she lives for long walks, runs, and exploring

Affectionate — she loves human company and cuddles

Strong and spirited — she needs confident, experienced handlers who can continue her training

Luna will thrive in an active, outdoorsy home with people who can match her energy and give her the structure, exercise, and love she craves. She’s not just a pet — she’s a loyal, adventurous companion waiting for her second chance.

Please message us if you think you’re the one for her.

And even if you can’t adopt, a simple share could be the key to changing her life.

Let’s get Luna out of the shelter and into the loving home she’s dreaming of.

name: Eric
description:
Eric is a 6 year old male Lurcher still looking for a new home. He initially arrived in November 2019 and is labrador-sized.

PLEASE READ THE FULL DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING.

We have no known history for Eric as he was originally an unclaimed stray. He loves other dogs whilst out for walks and has lived with other dogs at the sanctuary. Eric is best suited to medium to large confident female dogs.

He has grown in confidence with us at the sanctuary but is initially timid of new people, particularly men. Eric can be the only dog at home but would also be happy to live with another confident female.

He is initially shy in new surroundings but once he becomes familiar, he is very good. Eric is more comfortable around women, and we feel a quiet home with no children or cats and few visitors would be best.

Eric will likely accept a male in the home but will always choose the lady first. Once he feels comfortable, he is a very happy and playful boy. He would be happy in a home where someone is around for most of the time—perhaps an active retired lady or couple.

Eric has previously been adopted but was returned due to his nervous reaction towards a stranger when out walking. He needs time and understanding as he is a real gentleman and perfect indoors. He is very clean indoors and loves his food—he could easily develop the figure of a Labrador if left to eat the quantities he’d like!

Eric is a perfectly adoptable dog, and we would love to see him settled in a new home. With the team here, he loves us, and he really is no trouble. It’s just a case of getting to know each other, building a bond, and knowing how to manage certain behaviours.

name: Freddie
description:
Freddie is a 7-year-old male Cross-Breed. He’s currently living in a loving foster home in Norfolk, where he’s surrounded by caring humans, dog friends, and even a cat who apparently thinks it’s one of the pack.

Freddie’s had quite the journey—originally from Romania, he spent over five years in a home before sadly being returned due to his sensitivity to loud noises and the arrival of a new baby.

Though he’s a larger dog in size, Freddie is all heart and very sensitive at his core. He’s not a fan of loud or sudden noises, and busy, bustling environments make him anxious.

For this reason, he needs a calm, quiet home—somewhere peaceful and predictable, ideally in a rural or low-traffic area.

Freddie is not suited to a city lifestyle or a home with children, but he would thrive in a calm, adult-only home with understanding people who get that he’s a bit of a gentle soul.

He does well with dog-savvy cats and currently lives with other dogs. He adores playing with his best friend, a smaller collie mix, but he can be wary of unfamiliar or larger dogs when out and about.

With the right setup and a patient adopter who’s willing to give him the time he needs, Freddie will reward them with deep loyalty, quiet companionship, and a big heart full of love.

name: Fergus
description:
Fergus is a 12-month-old male Cross-Breed. He is currently located in Spain and is looking for a loving family in the UK. Fergus is a medium-sized dog, standing around 24 inches at the shoulder and weighing 25kg.

He has a sleek black coat with a striking white chest and an affectionate, happy-go-lucky nature that makes him instantly likeable.

Fergus is friendly, playful, and gets on brilliantly with his kennel mates. Although he has settled well into kennel life, what he really needs is a forever home of his own.

He’s eager to please and quick to learn, making him a fantastic companion for the right family. Fergus has seen cats through a fence and seemed fine, but he has not been fully tested with them.

He is neutered, has started his vaccinations, is blood-tested clear, and comes with his own passport.

He is now ready to travel to the UK to join a home where he can be cherished and continue to thrive.

name: Micky
description:
Micky is a 3year old male cross breed currently in Spain.

Friendly Micky is happy and affectionate. He is a medium sized crossbreed, with a tan, short coat and an attractive black masked face. Micky is a friendly chap, he’s very loving and has lots of energy.

He likes to be with other dogs and he will grow to medium size and be a chunky boy, so we are looking for a home with or without another friendly dog, and no cats, as he was tested and didnt like them. We think children need to be over 13 years.

Micky has low level Leish, and he takes a tablet each day to keep him safe. The tablets are about £4 for a months supply.

name: Duke
description:
Duke is a 1 year old male Mastiff Cross. He is a big, soppy boy who has a loving nature and is looking for a new home.

With his size and playful personality, he is best suited to a home with another large, nice-natured dog who can match his energy and keep him company.

Duke loves people and dogs alike, but because of his clumsy and boisterous ways, he is not suitable for a home with small dogs.

Despite his size, he is a well-mannered lad who walks nicely on a lead, responds well to guidance and is eager to please. His affectionate nature shines through, making him an incredibly loving companion.

Duke will need a home where someone is around for most of the time, though he can be left for a few hours once he has bonded with the resident dog.

A secure garden and plenty of space to play are important for him, given his size and energy levels. He is fully vaccinated but still too young to be neutered.

Duke is great with children who are dog respectful, though due to policy he cannot be placed in a home with children under 8. He is not suitable to live with cats, but for the right family, he will be a loyal and affectionate friend.

name: Bailey
description:
Bailey is a beautiful, gentle soul who has endured a heartbreaking past. Rescued from a notorious kill shelter, she carries the emotional scars of being attacked by other dogs.

Fearful and timid, Bailey flinches at shadows and unexpected sounds, struggling to overcome her trauma. Despite her past, she remains a kind and loving girl who just needs a safe, patient home where she can heal.

Bailey has “cherry eye,” a treatable condition, and is otherwise in good health. She is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, 4D tested, and brucellosis tested.

With her own passport, she is ready to travel to a forever home where she will finally experience love and safety.

Bailey is good with children and would thrive in a home that can provide her with security, patience, and gentle encouragement.

She is looking for a hero to help her move past her fears and discover happiness again.

name: Yasmin
description:
Yasmin is a 15-month-old female Cross-Breed. She was rescued on July 8th, 2024, along with her sister, when she was just a 7-month-old puppy. Since then, she has been on a journey of learning to trust people and adjusting to a life filled with love and care. Though initially shy, Yasmin’s gentle nature is unmistakable, and she has already made great progress in overcoming her fears.

She finds great comfort in the company of other dogs, enjoying their presence and playful interactions. Being around her canine companions helps her feel safe and secure, and she thrives in an environment where she has the support of friendly dogs. While Yasmin is still learning to fully trust humans, she shows a sweet and affectionate side that continues to grow with time and patience.

With consistent love and reassurance, Yasmin is expected to blossom into a confident and happy companion. She enjoys human contact, and while she may need extra time to feel completely comfortable, she has already come a long way. Her resilience and ability to adapt show just how much potential she has to become a loving and devoted pet.

Yasmin is in excellent health and fully prepared for her forever home. She has been 4D tested, spayed, microchipped, fully vaccinated, and tested for Brucellosis. She also has her own passport, making her ready to travel to her new family.

At just 15 months old, Yasmin is still very much a young and playful girl. She has a beautiful appearance and a gentle personality that will flourish in the right home. If given the patience and kindness she deserves, she will undoubtedly reward her new family with love and loyalty.

If Yasmin has captured your heart, please reach out. She is waiting for a loving home where she can continue to grow into the wonderful dog she is meant to be.

name: Petra
description:
Petra is a 5 year old female Labrador Cross. She is a sweetheart, she is great with the other dogs and has shown herself to be sweet and loving.

Petra can be a bit of a loner watching on, but she is not worried just enjoys her own company. With humans, she can be shy, but we believe she will grow in confidence with her own home.

Petra is child-friendly and ignores cats. She will be a great dog to have as a companion!

Petra comes with full RBU, is vaccinated and microchipped, has a passport and is spayed.

name: Chestnut
description:
Chestnut is a 5 year old male Cross-Breed. He is a really lovely chap, he is energetic and fun and loves to play and run.

Chestnut can be shy with humans but soon warms up once he knows you, and is then affectionate and loving.

Chester has been cat tested and passed, but we cannot guarantee he will be friendly with every cat.

Chestnut is child friendly too. Chester is not keen on other dogs however and would need to be homed as the only dog.

As with all our dogs Chester comes with full RBU, is vaccinated and neutered, has a passport and is microchipped.

name: Maveric
description:
Maveric – 2 year old male Cross-Breed is the pocket rocket of happiness!

Maveric, our newest rescue, is a true bundle of joy on four paws! This little dynamo loves nothing more than zooming around and spreading happiness wherever he goes.

Maveric adores people of all sizes, especially kids, and dreams of finding a family where he can be the shining star. But Maveric also thrives on being the center of attention, so he would prefer to be the only pet in his forever home.

Maveric’s charm is undeniable—his bright eyes and wagging tail are sure to melt your heart! His playful antics and affectionate nature make him the perfect companion for cuddles and adventures alike. Whether he’s chasing after toys or snuggling up on the couch, Maveric’s zest for life is contagious! With his agile moves and endearing personality, Maveric will light up anyone’s life!

Together, we can make Maveric’s dreams come true! If our little Top Gun has zoomed into your heart, please get in touch. We would love to hear from you!

name: Gabby
description:
Gabby is a 3 year old female Cross-Breed. She has had a rotten start to her little life. Our rescue team found her in the kill shelter with two puppies.

Gabby was a devoted Mum but tragically the puppies had parvo and did not survive, despite them fighting very hard.

Darling Gabby has overcome such tragedy and has shown to be kind, affectionate loving and playful. She is all so child friendly. Gabby so deserves her happily ever after!

If you can offer this beautiful girl a home we’d love to hear from you! Gabby comes with full RBU, is vaccinated and microchipped, has a passport and is neutered.

name: Kyle
description:
Kyle – 3-year-old male Labrador Retriever

Kyle was a ghost, slipping between the cracks of a world that had forgotten him. When we found him in a kill shelter in December 2024, he wasn’t barking for help, he wasn’t fighting for food—he was hiding in the farthest corner of the last cage, waiting to disappear.

Too weak to move. Too terrified to hope. Too broken to believe anyone would come for him. If we hadn’t seen him, truly seen him, Kyle wouldn’t have survived another day. He would have starved, been attacked, or simply faded away—forgotten.

So we saved him. But Kyle still doesn’t know he’s safe. He is gentle, but the world has not been gentle to him. He is kind, but he doesn’t yet believe in kindness.

Kyle has never been loved, and he doesn’t know what it feels like. He is struggling in the pension. The noise, the movement, the overwhelming presence of other dogs—it’s too much for a soul as fragile as his.

He doesn’t belong in a group setting. He needs peace, patience, and a heart willing to teach him what love truly means.

Kyle doesn’t need pity—he needs a chance. A chance to learn that hands can be gentle. A chance to wake up without fear. A chance to finally rest. He has already survived the impossible. Now, he just needs someone to show him that life can be beautiful, too.

name: Giani
description:
When we found Giani, a 3 year old male Cross-Breed, in the kill shelter in December 2024, he was caged alone.

But because he had already been torn apart.

Attacked by bigger dogs, Giani fought for his life. When the fight was over, he had lost his eye—but worse, he had lost his trust. Alone in his cage, he didn’t cry, didn’t beg, didn’t expect kindness. He had given up.

We reached out for him, and he flinched. We spoke softly to him, and he lowered his head. And when we gently touched him, he let out the deepest sigh—as if he had been waiting his whole life to feel safe.

He learned that not all hands hurt—some heal. He learned that not all dogs attack—some become friends. And he learned that not all humans leave—some stay. Today, Giani is no longer the broken soul we pulled from that cage.

He is warm, loving, and full of hope. He craves human touch, leans into affection, and just wants to belong.

He has learned to trust other dogs and now gets along beautifully. But there’s one thing he still doesn’t have—a home.

He lost an eye, but he never lost his heart. He carries the scars of his past, but he is ready to love with all that’s left.

Will you be the one to look into his remaining eye and say, “You’re home now”?

Giani has waited long enough. Let’s make sure he never waits again. Get in touch to find out how to adopt this truly special boy.

name: Kito
description:
Kito was pulled from one of the notorious kill stations. Kito is a 4 year old male Akita who was underweight and malnourished. He was in desperate need of a good meal—several meals by the look of him, as he was so thin.

He absolutely loved his new surroundings when he was taken into our care and gets on great with absolutely everyone.

He has the most amazing character, and everyone just loves him. Kito just oozes happiness whenever you see him—he is always so happy. He gets on great with the other dogs and loves to play. Kito is a fantastic dog and will love being part of a family.

Daily walks and playtime will keep him happy, and then he would love to just curl up in his own bed or beside you, knowing that this is how life should be. Kito will bring so much happiness, friendship, and loyalty to his family—he will be an absolute joy to have around.

We provide full rescue backup for the life of the dog, and you can be assured of our commitment to ensuring we match the right dog to the right family.

If this handsome boy has captured your heart, please get in touch! We would love to hear from you and tell you all about him.

name: Allegra
description:
Allegra – 1.5 year old female Cross-Breed is the little dog who will steal your heart! Rescued on July 8th, 2024, she is truly perfect in every way. She has a gentle heart, a loving soul, and a happiness that shines through in every wag of her tail.

Allegra is everything you could ever want in a dog. She is calm, affectionate, and always ready to give love. She adores people, melts into cuddles, and greets everyone with a tail wag and a happy smile.

She’s fantastic with kids, other dogs, and everyone she meets. Whether you’re looking for a best friend, a family companion, or simply a dog to love and be loved by, Allegra is the one.

She will fit into any home and bring nothing but joy!

1.5 year old – young, loving, and full of warmthPerfect family dog – great with kids, adults, and other dogsGentle, affectionate, and loves human touchAlways happy, always wagging, always spreading loveWill make any home complete – a truly perfect companionAllegra is in perfect health:

Fully vaccinatedSpayed4D tested & healthyBrucellosis tested

name: Chita
description:
CHITA- BLACK LAB MIX – The Gentle, Wise Soul longing for a home!

CHITA is a 4-year-old Labrador size boy with a calm, wise nature and a heart full of kindness. He is a bit shy at first, but as soon as he hears your soft voice and receives the attention and cuddles, he opens up to show you his gratitude.

Chita was only a 6 month old puppy when he was rescued from a crowded kill shelter, where he was abused, and starving. His gentle nature however, remained untouched by the cruelty of his past.

His idea of happiness is a peaceful walk followed by lying quietly by his human’s feet, soaking up their presence with pure devotion. Chita has so much love to give, and all he asks for is a place to belong. Good with other dogs; Good with children

This fabulous boy would love to have a home to call his own, he has waited so long. Please get in touch if you’d like to adopt him, we would love to hear from you!

name: Penny
description:
Penny, a nine-month-old female, medium-sized crossbreed dog, awaits her forever family from Romania.

Found abandoned with her lineage a mystery, Penny’s journey has led her to seek love and companionship in a new home. Despite her tumultuous beginnings, Penny’s heart remains open, ready to embrace a family of her own.

In her foster home, Penny’s vibrant personality shines through, revealing a dog eager to explore the world and forge connections with both canine and human companions alike.

In the company of other dogs, Penny finds solace, relishing the opportunity to run and play. Her playful nature extends to her love for toys, with ball games holding a special place in her heart.

Penny’s affable demeanor extends to people as well, showing no fear towards men and displaying a friendly disposition towards all she meets. However, Penny’s distaste for solitude is evident, yearning for the company of her beloved humans.

While Penny may lack experience with children and cats, her curiosity knows no bounds, driving her to discover new adventures and experiences.

Despite her outgoing nature, Penny still requires guidance in certain situations, such as car rides and recall, highlighting her need for patient and loving training from her future family.

An ideal home for Penny would provide a secure garden for play and continued training, along with someone who possesses the time and patience to help her adjust to short periods of alone time.

Given her past experiences, Penny thrives in a rescue-experienced environment, where her unique needs can be understood and met with care.

Penny comes with a clean bill of health, having been vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, and microchipped. With her bright spirit and boundless potential, Penny eagerly awaits the chance to become a cherished member of a loving family.

name: Bentley
description:
Bentley is a 12-month-old male cross breed, currently residing in a private foster home in Romania. Weighing 10kg, he is vaccinated, blood-tested, flea/worm treated, neutered, and microchipped.

Bentley was found straying on the streets of Romania and is now in search of a loving family to call his own.

In his foster home, Bentley has not displayed any behavioural issues, making him a delightful companion. He is part of a household with other dogs, showcasing his compatibility with canine companions.

However, Bentley is not suited for a home with cats. He has been tested with various foods and shows no allergies, intolerances, or issues. Health-wise, Bentley has a clean bill, with no regular medication requirements.

When it comes to exercise, Bentley’s transition to a new home should initially focus on acclimating him to his surroundings. Positive support with the lead and harness is recommended, ensuring a smooth adjustment.

Bentley is looking for a home where people are mostly present, dedicated to his ongoing training, and can gradually increase his alone time.

Adopters must be mindful of their actions and expectations, paying attention to Bentley’s body language during potentially stressful interactions. A calm environment that offers structure and time for decompression is essential.

Positive reward training is encouraged, and a secure garden with a minimum 6ft boundary is required. Bentley is best suited to a home with no children or cats, and adopters should be prepared to provide toilet training support.

name: Tilly
description:
Tilly is a 2 1/2 year old female Spanish Mastin.

Tilly has had a sad start to her life. She was born in a pig sty and her owner decided he didn’t want her, or her parents – Bonnie and Henry. So he turned them out onto the streets.

They scavenged for food, and when they old owner saw them in quite a sorry state he threatened to shoot them. The family came into our March 2023.

Tilly was nursed back to health and has turned into a beautiful loving gentle lady. She is good at the vets and in the car.

Tilly has been around other dogs, and older children.

A secure garden, ideally rural/semi rural would be ideal. Tilly would be happy with another dog or as an only dog.

Tilly will need someone patient and understanding and have the time to continue her training.

Large breed experience preferred but not essential.

Tilly is in kennels in Cordoba, Spain, but is ready to travel to the right home.

name: Bonnie
description:
Bonnie is a 3 year old female Spanish mastin.

Bonnie spent her first two years of her life living in a pig sty, fed only on leftovers from the pigs.

She lived there with a male mastin Henry and despite their living conditions she gave birth to just one puppy – Tilly.

At this point her owner decided he didn’t want them any more, so he turned them out onto the streets and when they stayed close to the only place they knew he threatened to shoot them.

We were altered to them and arranged for them to be taken to a place of safety.

Bonnie is a gentle lady, who just wants a place to call home where she will be loved.

Bonnie will need a secure garden, in a rural/semi rural area. Someone with the time to teach her to trust again.

Bonnie gets on well with other dogs when out and about.

Her ideal home would be with a male dog or as an only dog. Bonnie has not been cat tested. She is good at the vets.

name: Carmen
description:
Meet sweet little Carmen, an 8 year old female Podenco Maneto.

As Carmen grew older, her owners decided they didn’t want her anymore and left her at the pound.

Carmen is looking for her very own home and would prefer to be an only dog so she gets all the attention.

She enjoys a quiet home but loves to go out and run in a secure field.

Carmen doesn’t like cats, rabbits, or chickens, but she gets on okay with other dogs, as long as they aren’t too bouncy or busy.

Carmen loves going in the car and was no trouble at all at the vets. She loves her food and, for an older lady, is very energetic.

name: Ringo
description:
Ringo is a 7 year old male Sarplaninac Cross under the care of Azil Danica (Network for Animals Bosnia).

He is a gentle giant with a heart even bigger than his size. Calm, stable, and shy by nature, he has spent his entire life in the shelter. Once, he was adopted to guard a house but was returned because he did not bark — he was simply too calm. Imagine that.

Yesterday, for the first time in his life, Ringo discovered toys and started to play. They took away his childhood and his youth, but he still believes in kindness.

He is wonderful with children, completely non-reactive towards other dogs and cats, and simply wants peace, warmth, and a place to finally rest his head in a home of his own.

Application and checks apply.Rescue support and backup in the UK via Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue.

name: Mischu
description:
Mischu is an 11 year old male Cross-Breed. He must live in a dog and pet-free home. Mischu came to us with his sister Iza after spending 8 years in a shelter with very little human socialization.

When they came to us they were very scared and shy dogs. He is very bonded with his sister but isn’t keen on other dogs so if they are rehomed separately he needs to be in a pet and dog-free home.

When they arrived they were both very scared of everything, but over time have relaxed into life here and become firm favorites with our volunteers.

Mischu is the most confident of the two, but his little sister Iza definitely wears the pants in their relationship.

Mischu loves doing the zoomies, snoozing, food, and a cuddle.

He will need work on lead training so his family will need a secure home and garden to begin his training.

If you can offer him, love, comfort and patience we would really like to hear from you.

name: Bentley
description:
Meet Bentley – the gentle boy with a heart full of love! Bentley is a handsome and lovable large/medium boy who is looking for his forever home.

Bentley is a five month old male Cross-Breed. He may be a big boy in size, but his heart is even bigger! Bentley’s journey has not been an easy one. Rescued as a puppy, he spent his early years in a Romanian vet clinic after being diagnosed with diabetes.

Despite his condition, Bentley remained a sweet and affectionate pup, but sadly, no rescues offered to take him on due to the ongoing medical costs. That’s when we stepped in and brought him to the UK in June 2024, giving him the second chance he truly deserves.

Since arriving in the UK, Bentley has flourished! With regular vet visits and medication, his diabetes is now stable. He is such a trooper and takes his daily medications and regular blood tests in stride.

Bentley is the most patient, gentle, and loving dog you’ll ever meet, and his calm, positive nature makes him a joy to be around.

Bentley’s diabetes does require him to follow a strict diet to keep his glucose levels stable. His adoptive family will need to commit to maintaining this routine, but Bentley’s loving nature and wonderful personality make it all worthwhile.

He gets along beautifully with other dogs and has also lived alongside cats in the vets, so he’d be happy in a multi-pet household. His favourite things include sunbathing, cuddling with his human friends, and being the centre of attention (he’s quite the charmer!).

Bentley has won the hearts of everyone who meets him, and it’s impossible not to smile when you see his sweet face. Despite his remarkable qualities, Bentley has had little interest from potential adopters. We believe this is largely due to his ongoing medical condition even though he rarely needs to see a vet now that his condition is well under control.

As a charity, we are committed to continuing Bentley’s insulin medication costs for as long as necessary, but what he truly needs now is a family who will appreciate his kind spirit and give him the love he deserves.

Please note that Bentley would thrive in an adult-only home where he can live safely with his strict diet and no temptation for food outside of his prescribed meals.

We know Bentley has so much love to give, and with your help, he’ll find the perfect home where he can live the rest of his days surrounded by warmth, love, and cuddles. Thank you for considering giving this incredible boy the life he deserves!

name: Lana
description:
Lana is a stunning 2 year old female crossbreed who needs a new home of her own through no fault of her own.

She was originally saved from being beaten on the streets in Uzbekistan as a puppy and they thought from her markings she was a Jack Russell.

However she is now 30kg and was far too large for the couple who saved her (who are in their 80s) to cope with. Their daughter brought her to the UK but lives in an apartment with no outdoor space and Lana simply doesn’t cope with city centre living and no garden.

She’s a wonderful girl and happily met me at her assessment, had a sniff, licked my hand and trotted beside me. We are told she can be barky with some strangers, more so men but she was great yesterday.

She lives with a male dog and until six months ago lived with cats so a home with another dog or with cats would be considered. She goes to daycare and is fine there but can sometimes be too OTT with some dogs if she doesn’t know them.

We’ve no idea what mix she is but think there may be some hound in there as she can be vocal. She walks pretty well and is very food motivated which helps with training.

She’s not been around children so a home with respectful teenagers or adult only is needed. She is vaccinated, speyed and chipped.

Forever homes can be anywhere within the UK but you will need to travel to meet her in Warwickshire.

As always we require everyone in the family and any children who are regularly going to be in contact with the dog to attend the meet. Our usual process is that you will need to come and meet the dog and that adoption is then done on a second meet. For some dogs additional meets may be required and potential adopters will be required to travel to the dogs location for all meets.

If you are suited we will then arrange a homecheck, vet reference and meet with the dog.

We only rehome where all resident and previous animals are/were regularly vaccinated and neutered/speyed unless on veterinary advice. All of our dogs have rescue back up.

name: Ferran Torres
description:
Ferran Torres is a stunning 1 year old Crossbreed weighing 14 kg, who has such a wonderful sweet nature.

Rescued from the municipal pound, Ferran quickly settled into shelter life. Now in a foster home in Berkshire with two other resident dogs, he is doing superbly.

For such a young dog, Ferran really does have an older dog’s head on his shoulders. He is so calm, he learns quickly and is clean indoors. Ferran loves his walks.

He can initially be nervous of new routes but gains confidence quickly, giving his foster happy spins when he realises where he is!

He sits for treats without being asked and has learned door boundaries quickly – he just wants to be with his human. And oh boy does he love his human – in fact, he’s an utter cuddle bug!

Ferran can be nervous of new people at first but quickly learns to trust. He has zero prey drive and walks so nicely – his foster tells us that every walk is a joy.

He can be nervous around bouncy dogs but greets calm dogs with a polite sniff. Ferran has so much potential as he is so quick to learn, though he is still a little nervous, due to lack of exposure.

Some mindful training and desensitisation will be needed to have him feeling 100%.

Ferran’s foster Mum says: ” He is the sweetest dog and a joy to be around.”

Could you be the loving home that Ferran Torres has been waiting for?

All of our dogs have an international passport (unless born in the UK) and are microchipped. They are fully vaccinated for standard diseases as well as rabies and kennel cough.

All dogs are blood tested for infectious diseases including Leishmaniasis, Dirofilaria, Ehrlichia, Babesia, Anaplasma, Lyme and Brucella canis.

All dogs, unless there are medical or behavioural reasons to not do so, will be sterilised. Ferran Torres is neutered. Please note that we will advise medical results and treatments upon successful application.

Adoption contract and fee, homecheck and lifetime RBU (rescue back-up) apply as standard.

name: Katie
description:
Four-year-old Katie is a medium-sized sweetheart (around 15 kg) with the softest nature and a beautiful smiley face. She’s friendly, sociable, affectionate and absolutely loves people!

Her tail never stops wagging and she’s so happy whenever she gets attention. She’s also great with children.

Katie is wonderfully easy-going with other dogs and loves to play with them. She’s a little on the submissive side, with a gentle, sweet personality that makes her a lovely companion.

Sadly, Katie’s story hasn’t been an easy one. She was rescued from the streets three years ago, but somehow ended up in a very unsuitable foster home where she was left alone for long hours and wasn’t given the care and attention she deserved.

We recently rescued her from that situation and now it’s finally time for Katie to find the loving home she’s been missing.

This beautiful girl deserves so much more than simply having a roof over her head. She deserves to be part of a family, to enjoy companionship, playtime, cuddles and all the little things that make a dog feel truly loved.

Katie is in Hungary, ready to travel once a home has been secured for her.

She comes neutered, fully vaccinated, with an EU passport.

name: Nico
description:
Meet Nico – A Pocket-Sized Breton with a Big Personality!

Nico is a little dog with a huge personality! Nico is a four-year-old male Breton weighing approx 10 kg.

He was rescued from a hunter who no longer wanted him and is currently enjoying life in a foster home in Somerset, where he is learning how to live in a home and discovering all the comforts of family life.

Ex-hunting Breton Nico was quite compressed on arrival to foster after his journey, but with his foster family’s excellent care, he is decompressing well and gradually fitting into his foster pack.

He does sometimes ever so slightly push his luck with his canine foster siblings, but is quickly learning the rules of the house.

He can sometimes be a little over exuberant when it comes to play, and if he has no luck with the dogs, he’ll instead invite random objects to play, which he doesn’t seem to have much success with!

Nico is very affectionate with people and can get a little attached, but it’s early days after many changes for him in a short period of time.

Nico loves toys and likes to take them out to the garden to hide, but he also loves to play with the other dogs. He sleeps well next to them and has progressed from sleeping, as many working dogs do, on a hard floor to feeling comfortable in a dog bed.

He is getting used to all the comforts a home brings and is a bit of a counter-surfer. He is however, quick to learn when corrected.

Nico is learning to walk well on a lead and loves the car. His foster family are also working on his house training which is coming along nicely.

We would particularly love to find Nico an active individual or couple who understand and appreciate the Breton breed and its working instincts.

A home where he can enjoy scentwork, tracking, mantrailing or other nose-led activities would be ideal. He needs opportunities to use his brain as well as his little legs!

Nico could live happily with other friendly dogs and would enjoy having canine company. He can be a little enthusiastic during play, so a family willing to continue guiding him as he settles would be perfect.

Due to his hunting background and prey drive, he would not be suitable for a home with rabbits, birds or other small animals. Cats would need careful assessment.

Could you be the special person who gives this little pocket rocket the forever home he deserves?

All of our dogs have an international passport (unless born in the UK) and are microchipped. They are fully vaccinated against standard diseases, as well as rabies and kennel cough.

All dogs are blood tested for infectious diseases, including Leishmaniasis, Dirofilaria, Ehrlichia, Babesia, Anaplasma, Lyme and Brucella canis. All dogs, unless there are medical or behavioural reasons not to do so, will be sterilised. Nico is already neutered.

Please note that we will advise medical results and treatments upon successful application.

An adoption contract and fee, homecheck and lifetime RBU (rescue back-up) apply as standard.

name: Chip
description:
Our lovely, smiley boy Chip is a 2-3 year old hound cross. He is a gentle, calm and affectionate boy currently being fostered in Hertfordshire.

He first came to us after being found as a stray in Cyprus, and he slotted into the shelter without any fuss at all. In the months he remained with us, he was always a very good boy with an unassuming nature, often blending into the background in some cases.

Now in a foster home, Chip is doing so well. We’re so glad that he’s had this opportunity and has finally stopped being overlooked in the shelter.

He’s the sort of dog who is very happy to see you without feeling the need to launch himself at you, instead quietly showing his excitement through a waggy tail and the sweetest little contented noises when he is being stroked.

He’s quickly become attached to his foster family and definitely already knows that he is loved.

Chip enjoys being outdoors and enjoys two walks a day. He is excellent on the lead and walks calmly and confidently while occasionally becoming distracted by an interesting scent – he is a hound after all!

He hasn’t been off lead yet as his recall is still being worked on and he has shown some prey drive, so his new family will need to continue building this gradually and sensibly.

Chip is very good with other dogs and is particularly gentle when playing. He regularly spends time with a much smaller dog and happily adjusts his play style to suit her.

He is calm when meeting dogs on walks and shows no signs of being territorial. Although he could potentially be happy as an only dog, his foster feels that having another suitable dog around may help him feel more settled when left.

He also shared his kennel with various other dogs in Cyprus, and he got along with everyone. He is great at reading the room and recognising how to behave around different characters.

At home, Chip is housetrained and is beginning to discover the joys of toys, although he is still very much learning how to play. He is not possessive over his food or belongings and is perfectly happy for his bowl or toys to be handled.

He does enjoy his food, with chicken being a particular favourite, but he isn’t overly food focused.

Chip’s main area for development is being comfortable when left alone. He is currently very attached to his foster and can become unsettled when she leaves, even if other people remain at home, although they are working on this with him.

His new family will need to introduce alone time gradually and give him the support and confidence he needs to learn that being apart from his people is nothing to worry about. We do feel that this response could lessen with the company of another dog at home.

Chip is also very good natured with people and has been lovely with everyone he has met. He is around the size of a Labrador, so his foster feels a home without very young children would be preferable.

He does get excited to chase any cats that enter the garden, so we’re looking for a home without resident felines!

The only other thing to note is that although he was estimated to be around 2-3 years old, we think that Chip could actually be a bit older based on his teeth, but unfortunately this is anyone’s guess.

It’s hard not to fall for Chip’s charming character, as well as his gentle nature, lovely manners and affectionate personality. Chip has already shown himself to be a very easygoing dog who is a joy to have around.

He would suit a home that can offer him regular walks, plenty of companionship and the patience to help him build confidence when left alone.

A friendly canine companion could be a real bonus, but above all he needs people who will appreciate his calm, sweet nature and give him time to settle into his new life.

name: Claudia
description:
Our beautiful girl Claudia is an 11 month old hound cross, and she is unfortunately seeking a new forever home. She is now just under a year old and is living in Stafford.

She’s a very balanced, confident and friendly young dog, and she has made an amazing amount of progress in the short few months she has been in the UK, but sadly her current family’s toddler is still too young to understand her boundaries.

Her family feel it’s not fair on her, and are therefore looking to rehome her.

Claudia is an incredibly sociable girl who loves meeting everyone and is always delighted to welcome visitors. She’s very enthusiastic and trusting, even with people she doesn’t know very well, and she’s always eager to make new friends.

At home, she’s very affectionate and will happily curl up on the sofa after a busy day, leaning against you for comfort, or giving you a gentle tap to request a chest rub.

As you might expect from a young Hound, Claudia has a real passion for following her nose! She loves woodland walks, exploring unfamiliar places and investigating interesting scents, and is rarely fazed by new experiences.

Her ideal day would involve a long morning walk, any opportunity to interact with canine friends, and then back home for a well earned nap, followed by a little more exploring or playing in the garden.

She is equally happy accompanying her family on trips to cafés and enjoys having visitors around. She’s definitely a sociable dog and adapts well to new situations.

Claudia currently lives as the only resident dog, but she particularly enjoys the company of other dogs and is friendly with all ages and sizes.

She regularly attends doggy daycare and loves socialising with her canine friends, so her family feel she would benefit from living with another friendly, playful dog.

The daycare staff have also commented on her brilliant behaviour and ability to mix well in groups.

She’s a very smart girl who enjoys learning and has already made excellent progress with her training, including commands such as come, close and middle.

Her recall on a long line has improved considerably, and she regularly checks back with her family while exploring. She can still pull on the lead and becomes particularly interested in squirrels, so continued training around distractions should be expected.

Claudia’s current family have made the difficult decision to rehome her because she has been finding life with their toddler increasingly stressful.

This is also the only reason that they’re rehoming her, as they have stressed that she is otherwise a fantastic companion.

Although Claudia has generally been patient, their young child is not yet able to recognise when she needs space and has sometimes chased her, pulled her tail or hit her, and she is now getting uncomfortable and stressed by his unpredictable behaviour.

With older children who understand how to interact appropriately with dogs, Claudia has really enjoyed their company.

She loves playing football with children aged seven and upwards and has happily greeted visiting children with a very waggy tail, including those arriving for Halloween.

An adult household or one with older, dog savvy children who can recognise and respect her boundaries would be a much better fit.

Claudia is housetrained and crate trained, and has adapted well to her new routine. She enjoys playing with toys, although soft toys tend to be enthusiastically dismantled, and is particularly fond of long lasting chews and hiding treats around the house.

Like many clever young dogs, she can become mischievous when she hasn’t had enough exercise or mental stimulation, occasionally chewing something she shouldn’t or digging in the garden.

She is also very food motivated and has learnt exactly which family members might be persuaded to share their dinner! Claudia has a known intolerance to chicken, so her diet will need to remain chicken free, but she’s happy eating turkey and rice kibble.

Claudia would be best suited to an active family living in a semi-rural area or somewhere with easy access to parks, woodland and interesting walks.

The reason for rehoming aside, Claudia has otherwise been amazing since arriving, and has settled into life as a companion so successfully.

She adores people, she’s loyal, friendly, well behaved and highly trainable. With an adopter who enjoys training, exploring and plenty of snuggles on the sofa, she’s going to absolutely flourish. She’s a very good girl with a heart of gold.

attributes.Breed: Jack russell cross beagle cross dachshund

name: Sylvie
description:
Sylvie is a two year old female Jack Russell/Beagle/Dachshund type cross, currently being fostered in Lincolnshire, where she is winning everyone over with her affectionate nature and enthusiasm for life!

She is an incredibly friendly, playful dog who absolutely adores people and wants to make friends with everyone she meets.

Whether it’s enjoying a fuss, playing with her favourite toys or bouncing around with excitement, Sylvie is a happy go lucky little girl with a very positive attitude.

Sylvie loves human company and is always delighted to receive attention.

She has been lovely with the children she has met and is happy to be stroked and fussed over, although she can become very excitable and although she’s a short little thing, she has an impressive ability to jump!

Her foster is working on teaching her to keep all four paws on the floor, so this is something her new family will need to continue, particularly around younger children.

She is a sociable girl who enjoys being involved in family life and would suit a home where she can enjoy plenty of companionship, playtime and affection.

Sylvie loves playing with her toys and she is always ready for a game. She hasn’t quite mastered the concept of fetch yet, but she’s trying! She also enjoys getting out for walks and is already doing well on the lead.

She can pull a little and has a habit of zigzagging as she explores, but nothing excessive, and her foster is helping her develop some better walking manners.

With moderate exercise needs and a playful personality, Sylvie would enjoy a family who can offer her regular walks alongside plenty of opportunities to play and learn.

Sylvie is also very enthusiastic about other dogs, although her excitement can sometimes get the better of her. She currently lives with another dog and loves seeking out his company, encouraging him to play and snuggling up to him.

However, she doesn’t always recognise when another dog might appreciate a little personal space and can be rather bouncy in her attempts to make friends.

She will benefit from continued guidance around appropriate greetings and learning to read other dogs’ signals.

One important area that Sylvie’s new family will need to understand is her behaviour around food and resources.

Although she enjoys the company of her foster’s resident dog, she has shown significant guarding behaviour around mealtimes, particularly when she finishes eating before him.

To manage this, it is necessary to feed her separately. Aside from this though, she is brilliant with the resident dog.

Given her confident, sociable nature, she could cope as the only dog in the household, where she can enjoy all the attention and her food and toys without competition.

Sylvie is a clever little character who is beginning to learn her basic commands. She can sit for a treat, is working on lying down and is starting to understand when she is being asked to stop doing something.

She is also doing well with her housetraining, with only a few accidents in her foster home, and will use puppy pads when needed.

She isn’t crate trained, and although she has managed being left for around two hours with the resident dog, she has shown some signs of separation anxiety.

She hasn’t been destructive, but would benefit from a home where time alone can be introduced gradually and her confidence with being left can continue to develop.

Sylvie would suit a home in a residential or semi-rural area with people who enjoy an affectionate, energetic and slightly mischievous companion.

She has so much enthusiasm for people and other dogs, but still needs help learning how to manage that excitement and understand boundaries.

Her new family will need to be patient and consistent with her training, particularly around jumping up, interactions with other dogs and resource guarding.

There is a great deal to love about Sylvie. She is affectionate, sociable and full of personality, with a playful nature that makes her a lot of fun to have around.

With the right guidance and a home that understands the areas she still needs help with, she has every opportunity to develop into a wonderful companion.

name: Kansas
description:
Meet gorgeous Kansas, a dinky little Staffy girl who is just 2 years old, weighs a neat 17 kilos and stands just 32 cm at the shoulder!

In true staffy style, Kansas is an affectionate girl who absolutely adores human company. She’s particularly happy when she has someone all to herself, enjoying a bit of one-to-one attention.

Kansas has come from a multiple dog home where her energy levels were just too much. She’s a pocket rocket that needs controlled exercise and some extra training she is not aggressive in any way.

Hence, we believe she would be better as an only dog and with older children.

Kansas is microchipped, has her passport, is fully vaccinated, blood tested and neutered. We are fortunate to have her complete history from birth including breed registration certificates that will not be divulged. Her bags are packed, and she’s ready to go!

She’s not asking for the world. Just someone to love, regular walks, a comfy place to snooze and a home to finally call her own.

Could you be the happy ending Kansas is waiting for?

name: Rocky
description:
Gorgeous Rocky, a 2 year old male Beagle, is a social, happy go lucky chap waiting to steal the hearts of his new adopters.

He is a typical beagle who loves to take his time to carefully view the world through his nose and wants to remind you to slow down on walks while he inspects each blade of grass for valuable information!

He may be up for plenty of outdoor adventures, but he also loves some time to snuggle up beside his favourite people.

He is keen to meet dog pals on his travels but is still learning so will need ongoing guidance around who does and doesn’t want to join him for a game in the park.

He is an intelligent and active boy looking for owners that will have the time and patience to continue with his training and socialisation and provide him with the mental and physical stimulation he needs to thrive.

This absolute sweetheart will make the most amazing companion and teammate in the right home.

Rocky can live in a flat as long as there is direct access to a private garden. He can be vocal at times so this should be taken into consideration. Rocky builds strong bonds and can become stressed when left alone.

He’ll need a home where someone can be around during the day to keep him company. He is also looking for an adult only home to help him settle.

He could potentially live with another well-matched dog subject to a successful meet at Mayhew.

Rocky could live with a dog confident cat, providing new adopters are willing to put in the management involved and take the time to teach Rocky not to chase.

Rocky has been microchipped, neutered and vaccinated and is up to date with flea & worming treatment. He has also been health checked and behaviourally assessed. Lastly, every dog adopted from us will go home with 4 weeks free pet insurance.

name: Lottie
description:
This is the beautiful Lottie who is a 5 months old Pointer x puppy with an unusual tri colour short soft coat.

Lottie is a very beautiful and friendly young girl, she just adores lots of cuddles and loves to play with her kennel mates.

Lottie has started lead training and is toileting outside, she loves toys and will get onto your lap as much as possible, she’s still a baby and like all pups, needs some on going training but she’s been great at learning so far.

Sweet-natured girl, she’s great around cats.

Lottie has her passport and her puppy vacs in place so can travel for the right family, she will give you lots of love…..

She is a really a typical giddy puppy. She gets on really well with other dogs and will play with anyone, she just loves to be cuddled up with her people…..

We are looking for a home with or without other dogs with slightly older children as very excitable and giddy pup.

Breed : Puppy Pointer xAge : 5 months oldGender: femaleHeight: 42 cmLength: 45 cmWeight: 13 kg

name: Jamie
description:
Jamie is a five-year-old, medium to large-size Mastin cross lad that is very friendly with other dogs and people.

Jamie is a stunning boy with a soft black coat with brown markings. He is tranquil, gentle, very well behaved and eager to please. He is an intelligent dog that learns quickly and has a laid back temperament.

Jamie will be happy among children and other dogs. He has seen cats and has not reacted towards them.

There is nothing this lovely boy likes more than being stroked and cuddled. H enjoys walking and playing and sits down nicely to receive a treat.

Jamie’s mother was saved by the rescue when she was found, abandoned and heavily pregnant. Jamie was one of eight puppies.

He has been a joy to be around but now he needs a forever home that will love and care for him.

He also has a sister Emma looking for a home too.

Jamie is such a stunner, he is typical of the breed and is very submissive and always lies on his back so you can stroke his tummy. He is well behaved and follows instructions well.

He would make an ideal family pet and would be gentle enough for children over the age of 10 as he is a large boy.

Jamie has been castrated, has a microchip/passport and is ready to travel.

He is a really gentle and friendly dog. He gets on really well with other dogs and will play with anyone.

name: Dylan
description:
Handsome little Dylan is a small GSD type youngster aged 12 months and he has a soft, semi tan and black coat.

Dylan is a very affectionate smaller medium sized boy weighing 16kg, and he gets on well with his kennel mates, but he can be a bit boisterous and over excited at times (which is to be expected with such a young dog) so he would need some ongoing puppy training.

Poor Dylan was a bit of a bedraggled and scrawny boy when he first came into our care, full of fleas and ticks, and he had clearly been on the streets for a while!

And also he has been through a lot in the past few months, having to have an expensive operation to correct a completely dislocated leg joint too, but to see him now you really wouldn’t know he had any health issues at all.

Dylan has now gained weight and his coat is thick and shiny and he’s completely recovered from his operation, so he is ready to find his forever home.

Dylan would suit a home with other friendly dogs but we haven’t tested him for cats yet. We are looking for a home with children over 10 years old

He is a very happy cheeky boy and friendly dog. Gets on really well with other dogs and will play with anyone. Dylan nicely on his lead and is a very clever boy enjoying his walks and learning new commands as well as to be cuddled up with people.

name: Torete
description:
Torete is a medium English Setter, 3 years old.

Torete was taken in urgently by one of the shelters we work very closely with in Spain. His hunter no longer wanted him as he would get a little carried away on hunts and take the birds in his mouth!

His hunter’s solution was to shoot poor Torete but, thankfully, the ladies in Spain stepped in and got him to safety. Sadly, we are also told that the hunter used to beat him on hunts for not performing like he was expected to.

Although Torete has only just arrived, he is proving himself as a very good boy! He shares his kennel with other dogs and gets on really well with them.

Despite his terrible start to life, Torete still manages to trust people and is not afraid at the shelter. He approaches people seeking affection which is a true testament to his character given his past.

He’s affectionate, cheerful and good natured and also great with kids.

Torete is a very handsome lad with the most gorgeous eyes that are really striking! Torete can live as an only dog, as well as with others, and can be cat tested for the right home.

name: Iris
description:
Iris is a medium sized crossbreed aged around two years old. Iris fostered Norwich Norfolk.

We found Iris during a team trip to the Botosani public shelter in Romania. We’d been there for a few days when we just saw a nose appear above one of the boxes.

Iris was so stressed and traumatised by the shelter that she never came out from behind the boxes when people were around. We managed to retrieve her and get her where she could be seen to give her a chance of getting out.

A few weeks later we were able to offer Iris a foster space and she came into our care. Within days she was already getting braver and stopped hiding. Soon she was playing with the other dogs in her foster home and seemed comfortable to be near us.

She’s still a little wary and will only approach for fuss occasionally, she will need a less hectic home or foster home to really bloom into the dog she should always have been.

She is now starting to enjoy her walks but some aspects of the big wide world still need to be approached and become “normal” to her.

Everything will come together for her in time she simply needs someone with a kind heart to continue to show her that the world is not as scary as it once was for her.

Iris will need another confident dog or dogs in her forever home. She needs someone with an understanding of fearful dogs that will give her the time she needs to learn the life lessons that she should have been taught as a pup. She will need an adult only home.

name: Sunny
description:
Sunny is a small crossbreed aged around two years old. Sunny fostered Swaffham Norfolk.

Sunny was rescued from the public shelter in Slobozia, Romania, over a year ago. She weighed 4 kg. She was very thin, had been spayed by the shelter’s veterinarian, and had an infection in her abdominal area.

She had some horrible stitches. She was rescued and has been cared for in a private shelter until she joined us recently in the UK.

Sunny is a sweet and quiet little girl who is adjusting well to domestic life. She’s timid and easily spooked at times but getting braver daily.

She is wary of new people and will shy away from them but once she gets used to them is an affectionate little lap dog. She mixes well with other dogs but could also be the only dog in the home.

She is very good with cats. She will need a calm and quiet household where she can continue to grow in confidence. Visiting children would be fine but we would like her to go to a household with no children.

name: Lory
description:
Lory is a tiny crossbreed aged around ten years old. Lory fostered Taverham Norfolk.

Can you believe that a dog this tiny could survive on the streets of Romania? Her and another small dog were sleeping under cars.

Thankfully they were rescued and Lory was found to have previously suffered a trauma to her face which has left her toothless and the inside of her mouth is deformed. She struggles to eat some foods because of this.

Despite all this misfortune in her past, Lory is a cheerful and affectionate girl who loves a lap to sit on. She’s extremely cuddly and affectionate and mixes well with other dogs and cats.

She could also be the only dog in the home. We would like to find a calm home environment for her where she can at last be pampered like the princess she should always have been.

name: Fatima
description:
Fabulous Fatima, an 8 year old female French Bulldog, is a friendly, playful and loving little soul. She enjoys going for sniffy walks, often with her favourite toy in her mouth and loves a good game of fetch.

She can be worried around other dogs and prefers to keep her distance from them. She is looking for an understanding owner that will advocate for her and provide her with reassurance and guidance when needed.

She is an intelligent girl who enjoys her training and is eager to please. This sweet girl has been through a lot and can’t wait to find a cosy forever home where she can snuggle up on the sofa with her family.

She will make the most affectionate and loyal companion for the right match.

Fatima can live in a flat as long as there is direct access to a private garden. She could live with dog savvy junior school age children as long as they will give her space when needed.

She could possibly live with a dog confident cat providing her owners will facilitate slow intros. Her new owner will be expected to continue her training and socialisation and will receive three free 1:1 sessions with our Mayhew Animal Behaviourist to help guide them.

When Fatima arrived at Mayhew she had severe, widespread skin disease. She was treated with antibiotics, anti-inflammatory medication, parasite treatment and local skin care and the condition has now resolved.

She has also had a dental with extractions whilst with us. Fatima is a brachycephalic breed type, her adopter will need to be knowledgeable about brachy care and have researched her breed.

They will need to take care with excessive exercise and hot weather, maintain her weight and ensure her skin folds are kept clean.

Adopters will need to monitor Fatima’s overall condition and take her for regular vet check ups to maintain her good health.

Fatima has been microchipped, neutered and vaccinated and is up to date with flea & worming treatment. She has also been health checked and behaviourally assessed. Lastly, every dog adopted from us will go home with 4 weeks free pet insurance.

attributes.Breed: 4 and 5- poodle cross and chihuahua cross

name: Maple and Violet
description:
Maple and Violet are a bonded pair looking for a home together. Maple is a 5 to 6 year old female Poodle Cross, and Violet is a 4 year old female Chihuahua Cross.

Both girls arrived in our care from a home with 18 other dogs. While they were understandably timid at first, it did not take them long to settle in and show their true personalities.

They thrive on human company, love attention, and will happily curl up on your lap for cuddles.

Because they likely had limited exposure to the outside world in their previous home, they are still getting used to new sights and sounds.

They do not know many basic commands yet and can be vocal when passing unfamiliar dogs or strangers out on walks.

However, they are friendly with people once introduced and already walk alongside other resident dogs here at the kennels. With a bit of patience, positive training, and gentle socialisation, their confidence outdoors will continue to grow.

Family & Pets: Suitable for a home with older children and could potentially live with other dogs, pending successful introductions.

Care Needs: Adopters will need to continue their basic training and help build their confidence on walks. Please note that Maple’s coat will also require regular trips to the groomers.

If you are looking for two affectionate companions who just need a little guidance out in the world, Maple and Violet would love to meet you.

name: Kofi
description:
***KOFI IS CURRENTLY IN FOSTER IN BANSTEAD, SURREY ***

Our extra special boy Kofi is approximately three years old and an enormously attractive cross breed at the very bottom end of medium.

Kofi weighs just eleven kilos and measures eleven inches shoulder to paw. Having been surrendered by his owners, Kofi has been in our Cyprus shelter for one month.

Kofi is described by our shelter manager as shy and very well behaved. Having lived his life with a family, Kofi is overwhelmed by shelter life. His is a kind, loving and gentle little chap with a lovely smile.

His appearance is spectacular, and some would say cute. With a tri colour coat and white tips Kofi is so popular amongst the shelter staff and volunteers. Kofi is longing for his forever home, and his adopters will be truly blessed.

Kofi walks really nicely on his lead and thoroughly enjoys his time in the car. He seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Valentin
description:
Meet Valentin, a 1.5 year old male Hound Cross weighing 25 kilograms. He’s a beautiful young hound who has already been through so much in his short life.

Valentin came from a pound in northern Spain, where he was sadly stuck for six months before being rescued. Like many hounds in the region, he was likely a discarded hunting dog, but despite his past, he has kept his gentle spirit.

This lovely boy is in excellent health – he has been fully blood tested (including brucellosis), neutered, microchipped, and has his passport ready for travel.

Valentin gets along wonderfully with other dogs and would thrive in a home with canine companions. He can be a little timid when first meeting new people, but he warms up with patience and kindness and is incredibly loyal once he trusts you.

Valentin is ready to start the next chapter of his life – and he can travel! He is ready to travel, making it easier than ever to welcome him into your family.

As with all of our dogs, he comes with full rescue back-up for life.

name: Chiara
description:
Chiara is a 2.5 year old female Cross-Breed currently under the care of Network for Animals – Azil Danica in Bosnia. She was heartbreakingly dumped as a puppy outside the shelter with her siblings back in November 2023.

Sadly, due to a lack of promotion, she never got the chance to be adopted — but now it’s her time to shine and finally find her forever home.
