Chiara weighs around 15 kilograms, making her a perfectly medium-sized girl. She’s friendly, eager to please, and walks well on the lead.

She currently shares her kennel space with three other dogs and gets along wonderfully with them. She also ignores cats, making her a great fit for multi-pet homes.

Chiara is vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and spayed. She’s a happy, loving girl who’s ready to start her next chapter — one filled with warmth, care, and the family she’s always deserved.

Rescue support and backup by Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue.

name: Pirelli
description:
Pirelli is a 2 year old male medium Lurcher.

Pirelli came into our care as a stray and was never claimed by an owner. We believe he may have been used for working as he has a high prey drive and loves playing with squeaky toys.

He is one of our longest dogs on site and although he has walked with a couple of other sighthounds, he would love to be the only animal in his new home.

He does enjoy company of older children but can jump quite high and is very leggy so would best suit a home with teenagers.

A lover of all people and very inquisitive, Pirelli is fantastic at meeting and greeting and loves to run around off lead in a secure field. He is muzzled and kept on lead when out on walks due to his prey drive.

name: Splash
description:
Splash came into our care as a stray and was never claimed by an owner. He has struggled with kennel life and just wants a human to love.

Possibly from a working background, Splash’s prey drive is very high, and he is kept on lead and muzzled when walked but loves sprinting around in a secure field.

Splash does find a lot of things overwhelming and is looking for a calm and relaxed approach to life but with lots of fun and delicious treats at home.

Splash is very smart and does get quite excited when meeting new people. He is best suited with living teenagers and as the only animal.

He has however been walked with other sighthounds but does get over the top.

name: Sailor
description:
SAILOR — READY TO BECOME SOMEONE’S WHOLE WORLD

Sailor is a three-year-old Lagotto mix male.

Sailor has the kind of face that stays with you.

That handsome Lagotto look that makes you stop for a moment longer every time you see him.

But Sailor is more than just a beautiful dog.

He is a wonderful three-year-old boy, full of life, love and possibility, ready to become part of someone’s world.

Beautiful, proud and incredibly handsome, with a softness about him that makes you want to reach and touch those soft curls.

Sailor is good with other dogs and enjoys canine company. He could happily share his life with a compatible dog, or finally have all the love of a family to himself.

Young enough to have years of adventures ahead of him.

Ready for long walks, new places, familiar voices and the comfort of knowing exactly where he belongs.

Sailor deserves to be more than a beautiful face people pause to admire.

He deserves to have someone learn every expression in those eyes.

To become the dog whose presence is deeply woven into a home that life without him becomes impossible to imagine.

There is an entire lifetime inside this boy.

Years of love waiting to become part of someone’s story.

Ready for someone to look at him and see their boy.

3 years oldHandsome Lagotto mixGood with other dogsLoving, beautiful and ready for family lifeStrong, striking and full of possibilityLooking for a cat-free home

Fully vaccinatedNeutered4D testedBrucellosis tested

name: Maddie
description:
MADDIE — EVERYTHING A FAMILY COULD HOPE FOR!

The hardest thing about Maddie is knowing that a dog this beautiful inside is still waiting for someone to see her.

And she already carries the kind of nature that people spend years hoping to find in a dog.

Maddie is gentle in a way that reaches straight into your heart.

She is quiet, affectionate and soft in everything she does. She is simply a kind girl who makes being beside her feel peaceful.

And she is incredibly gentle and friendly with children.

Maddie has so much to offer a family, yet she asks for nothing more than the chance to belong to one.

A whole lifetime of loyalty, affection and companionship waiting to be given.

And somewhere, there must be a person or family whose life is missing exactly what Maddie carries.

1-year-old femaleSmall-to-medium-sized Lab mixWonderful with other dogsCat friendlyVery child-friendlyGentle, calm, affectionate and incredibly kindLead trained

Fully vaccinatedSpayed4D testedBrucellosis tested

Please do not let this beautiful girl grow up without ever knowing what it feels like to be someone’s whole world.

name: Remi
description:
REMI — THE KIND OF DOG WHO MAKES A HOUSE FEEL LIKE HOME

Remi is the kind of dog whose gentleness reaches you before anything else.

Before you notice how breathtakingly beautiful he is.

Before you notice his elegant Pointer features or his gorgeous silky coat.

The quiet warmth he carries wherever he goes.

Remi is three years old, and he is truly everything a family could hope for in a dog.

He is affectionate, beautifully mannered and wonderfully easy-going. He gets along perfectly with other dogs and has such a peaceful, balanced nature.

A softness that makes being around him feel easy.

He does not need to be loud to fill a space.

Remi is the kind of companion who would bring calm into a home, tenderness into ordinary days and the steady love only a truly good dog can give.

He is beautiful to look at, but it is his nature that stays with you.

Ready to become the dog someone will look at every day and wonder how they were ever lucky enough to find him.

Because Remi is not simply a perfect dog on paper.

He is the kind of dog who could make a home feel warmer just by being part of it.

3 years oldMedium-large, full-breed English PointerGets along beautifully with dogsCalm, gentle, affectionate and quietly joyfulWell-mannered, easy-going and a peaceful companion

Fully vaccinatedNeutered4D testedBrucellosis tested

name: Orchid
description:
ORCHID – THE KIND OF LOVE THAT CHANGES A HOME!

Orchid is a one-year-old female cross breed.

She saw us… and she chose us. Inside a kill shelter, surrounded by fear, noise, and dogs slowly giving up, Orchid stepped forward with everything she had — hope, trust, and a quiet plea to be taken out of that life.

We took her. And she never looked back. From that day on, she has lived every moment as if it matters — with joy, with softness, and a kind of gratitude you can feel just by being near her.

Orchid is a gorgeous, middle-to-small sized girl, around a year old, and she carries something incredibly rare — a heart that stays open, no matter what she has been through. She is also absolutely beautiful.

Orchid is happiness you can touch. With dogs, she blends in effortlessly — playful, social, kind. With people, she becomes soft and affectionate, always close, always connected.

With children, she is pure gentleness — patient, careful, and full of love. She brings light into a space without trying. She settles into your life as if she has always been part of it.

There is no heaviness in her. Only warmth, softness, and that quiet joy that stays. Orchid is the kind of companion who doesn’t just live beside you — she becomes part of your everyday rhythm, your calm, your happiness.

A small dog with a huge heart. A soul that chose life… and never stopped being grateful for it.

ORCHID AT A GLANCE:Around 1 year oldMiddle-small sized mixed breedGets along beautifully with all dogs & cat-friendlyGentle, cuddly, joyful, full of warmthEasy-going, people-oriented, naturally well-behaved

HEALTH:Fully VaccinatedNeutering to be arranged4D TestedBrucellosis TestedMicrochippedFull RBU

If you are ready for a dog who will fill your home with warmth, closeness, and gentle joy — Orchid is waiting for you.

name: Audrey
description:
Audrey is a one-year-old female Labrador x Pointer Mix.

There was a moment in her life when the world showed her its harshest side. Left by the road with her siblings, Audrey was only a tiny puppy, surviving on scraps and learning far too early what it feels like to be unwanted.

She grew into a beautiful, gentle girl with a quiet kind of presence. The kind of beauty that does not ask to be noticed. The kind that reveals itself slowly, like a flower opening when it finally feels the warmth of the sun.

Audrey carries a softness that cannot be taught. A gentleness that survived everything life placed in front of her.

When she first meets you, she may watch from a small distance.

Her eyes will follow you carefully, trying to understand who you are and whether she can let herself feel safe.

And then, little by little, she begins to come closer.

A small step. A gentle wag of her tail. A softness in her eyes that was not there before. And suddenly, you realise she is beginning to trust you. With Audrey, trust is never something ordinary.

AUDREY AT A GLANCE:1 year oldMedium-sized Lab mix × English PointerGets along beautifully with other dogsGentle, calm and lovingA little shy at first, but incredibly soft once she feels safe

HEALTH:Fully vaccinatedSpayed4D testedBrucellosis testedMicrochippedFull RBU

Audrey is not the loudest girl in the room. She will not push herself forward or demand to be chosen.But the love she carries is deep, loyal and incredibly pure.

She needs someone who understands that the most beautiful bonds are sometimes the ones that are given time. Someone patient.

Someone kind. Someone who will let her discover, at her own pace, that she is finally home.

And when Audrey truly feels safe, we know she will give everything she has been quietly holding inside.

Her trust. Her loyalty. Her whole heart. She is a quiet soul. A gentle girl. A beautiful life waiting for the person who will help her bloom.

If something in Audrey touches your heart, please send us a message.

She is waiting for someone who will see past that first shy moment and recognise the love already waiting underneath. We would love to hear from you.

name: Ebony
description:
Ebony is a 1-year-old female Cross-Breed. She’s a small dog weighing around 12 kilograms, with a soft, sweet expression that perfectly matches her gentle personality.

Her name might sound dark and mysterious, but underneath, she’s a sensitive soul with a big heart just waiting to shine.

At first, Ebony can be a little shy, especially in new surroundings or with unfamiliar people. However, once she realises she’s safe, her friendly and affectionate side begins to bloom.

She’s the kind of dog who will quietly observe before stepping forward for cuddles, making every bit of trust she gives feel like a real gift.

Ebony gets along well with other dogs and would thrive in a calm, understanding home where she can build confidence at her own pace.

A patient adopter will see her blossom day by day, gaining courage and showing more of her naturally kind, loyal nature.

She would especially benefit from living with a small or medium-sized resident dog who can help guide her and show her the ropes of home life.

Having a confident canine companion could help Ebony settle in faster and learn how to relax in her new environment.

Ebony is fully vaccinated and blood tested, with full rescue backup and support provided by Pennypaws Rescue. A home check via video will be required before adoption to ensure her new home is the right match.

Sweet and gentle Ebony would make a wonderful companion, and she’d make a great duo with her friend Noir. Together or on her own, she’s sure to bring warmth, quiet joy, and lasting love to the lucky family who welcomes her.

name: Kyro
description:
Welcome the very definition of joy in dog form — Kyro! Kyro is a four year old male Staffordshire Bull Terrier Cross, medium in size, with a huge grin, a happy-go-lucky personality, and endless enthusiasm for life. He’s truly impossible not to love.

Kyro is a fun-loving, affectionate lad who absolutely adores people. He’s happiest when he’s part of the action — whether that’s playtime in the garden, exploring new places on walks, or curling up nearby for a well-earned snooze afterwards.

He thrives on human companionship and has a wonderful, cheeky charm that makes everyone who meets him smile.

He’s also a clever boy who loves to learn. Kyro responds brilliantly to positive reinforcement and enjoys training sessions that keep his brain busy. He’s eager to please and loves to show off his progress — especially if there are treats or cuddles involved!

Kyro can be a little reactive towards other dogs, but we’re already helping him with this. With patient, careful introductions and ongoing guidance, he’s making fantastic progress.

He’s learning that not all dogs are something to worry about, and with continued support in his new home, he’ll only keep improving.

Kyro is fully vaccinated, microchipped, and awaiting castration, so he’s almost ready to start his next chapter with a loving forever family.

He’s currently in kennels, where he’s adored by everyone who meets him — but despite all the love and attention, Kyro does find kennel life a little stressful.

He would much prefer the comfort and calm of a home environment, where he can properly relax and show just how wonderful he really is.

Kyro is looking for a pet-free, adult-only home where he can be the centre of attention. He loves people, but he’ll thrive best in a calm, consistent environment without other pets or children.

If you’re looking for a companion who’ll make you laugh every single day and fill your home with warmth, Kyro might just be your perfect match.

name: Aria
description:
Meet Aria, a two year old female Staffordshire Bull Terrier Cross who’s medium to large in size.

Aria is a big-hearted girl with a lot of love to give, but she’s currently very overweight and needs someone experienced with large breed dogs who can provide her with structure, patience, and consistent boundaries.

Aria is a large, very overweight dog who needs someone experienced with large breed dogs and can teach her clear boundaries. They need to be confident in their training abilities or be prepared to seek out help from a trainer.

She needs regular exercise in a safe environment such as a dog field until she has built up her confidence around other dogs again. She will need to be on a strict diet to get her down to a sensible weight.

It is felt that Aria has become both traumatised and overprotective in her current home. She will need someone who is around most of the time but will build up some alone time for her too.

She has previously used a crate and may feel more secure using one again. She will need to be trained to use a muzzle and walk on a lead or long line at all times.

As Aria has been unpredictable with men lately, it is felt that she would be more suited to a female-only home. She needs to be treated like a dog and not a baby, have clear boundaries, and someone who can stick to them.

She is a dog with a lot of love to give but needs to be given time and patience to settle into her new home and understand her boundaries.

Aria travels well in the car and likes looking out of the window. Aria is a young girl who just needs someone with experience that understands her past is unknown but can work on her future together.

name: Skye
description:
Meet Skye, a two year old extra large male Cane Corso Cross. He’s a big, bouncy boy full of energy and affection, with that classic Cane Corso enthusiasm that can fill a room.

Skye is strong on the lead and tends to pull when out walking, but he’s doing well with muzzle training and is extremely food-motivated — a huge bonus for anyone who enjoys training with treats!

Skye hasn’t shown any signs of aggression toward his trusted volunteer in kennels, though he does like to bark at people and dogs — typical Cane Corso behavior.

He’s a loving dog who thrives on affection and attention. Skye would do best in a calm home without other pets or children, where he can get consistent training and structure.

He’ll need a dedicated owner who understands his background and is willing to help him move forward with patience and guidance. Skye must be walked on a muzzle, 5-point harness, and lead at all times — never off lead — to keep him safe.

He generally walks well but can get excited and grab the lead; with ongoing training, he’s learning to stop when told.

Skye will need someone around most of the time, with alone time introduced gradually once he’s settled. His new home should have a secure property and garden to prevent escape.

While he was house-trained in his previous home, he may need a quick refresher after his time in kennels.

Skye has missed out on a lot of love, but with trust and time, he’ll give back tenfold and become a loyal, affectionate companion.

name: Marlowe
description:
Marlowe is a 8-year-old male Husky Cross. He is currently in foster care in Lincolnshire and is looking for his forever home.

This sweet boy does have some health challenges, as he is already blind in one eye and sadly losing sight in the other. Despite this, Marlowe doesn’t let it get him down and remains a loving, affectionate companion.

Marlowe is well known for his cuddly nature, earning himself the title of a cuddle monster. He absolutely thrives on human company and enjoys being close to people.

He has so much affection to give, and his future family will quickly see just how loyal and gentle he can be.

Marlowe is described as extremely well behaved, making him a joy to have around the home. He gets on well with other dogs, showing that he is sociable and adaptable.

He has already been neutered and microchipped, which means some of the important essentials are already taken care of.

This lovely Husky Cross comes with lifetime rescue backup (RBU), showing the commitment of those who care about him to ensure he is supported throughout his life.

His only wish is to find someone who can accept his vision loss and love him for the wonderful dog he truly is. Please consider Marlowe—he has so much love still to share.

name: Darcy
description:
Darcy is a 2 year old female Cross-Breed. She’s a beautiful, friendly girl with a sweet nature and a big heart. Rescued from a terrible kill shelter, she’s now ready for a second chance at life and dreaming of a loving home in the UK.

It’s hard not to fall for her hopeful eyes and wagging tail that seem to say she knows her best days are yet to come.

Darcy’s love for people shines through in everything she does. She adores human attention, greeting everyone with warmth and trust despite her past. Her temperament is well-balanced — gentle, affectionate, and eager to please.

With her cheerful attitude, she’s bound to bring light and happiness to any home that welcomes her.

At the shelter, Darcy has shown herself to be a good girl with other dogs, interacting politely and confidently. She can be cat tested if needed, showing just how adaptable and eager she is to fit into different family environments.

Because she hasn’t had experience with very young children, a home with kids aged eight and over would be most suitable, giving her space to feel comfortable while still enjoying family life.

Weighing around 17 kilograms, Darcy is a medium-sized dog who’s already neutered, fully vaccinated, and has completed her full blood tests. She’s all set to travel with her passport and join her forever family directly — no delays, just love and new beginnings.

Darcy is ready to leave the shelter behind and step into a home where she’ll be cherished for the wonderful dog she truly is. Her rescue story may have started in hardship, but her future promises to be bright, filled with warmth, affection, and security.

name: Laura
description:
Our extra special girl Laura is approximately three years old and the most stunning medium sized cross breed. Laura weighs just twelve kilos and measures twelve inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been found abandoned on the streets, Laura has been in our Cyprus shelter for one month.

Laura can be best described as incredibly close to canine perfection.

Her smile is perpetual, her eyes are bright and engaging, her ears are prize winning, her teeth are shining white, and her glorious tri-colour coat is enhanced by an array of freckles and a pigmented tummy.

She adores her play time with her friends and engages beautifully with her bubbly sweet personality. If ever there was a prime adoption candidate designed to make a family unbelievably happy it’s Laura.

She walks nicely on her lead and enjoys her time in the car. Laura seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Hannah
description:
Our extra special girl Hannah is approximately three years old and a cross breed at the very bottom end of medium with a strong beagle appearance.

Hannah weighs a perfect eleven kilos and measures thirteen inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets, Hannah has been in our Cyprus shelter for three weeks.

Having clearly been preloved, Hannah is finding shelter life not to her liking. She is longing for her forever home away from the noise and bustle.

Hannah leans towards being timid but will thrive and blossom with her very fortunate adopting family. She yearns for peace and routine and will repay love and kindness with huge premiums.

Hannah’s appearance is exceptional in every aspect. Her tricolour coat is just glorious with some freckles and the loveliest ears ending in a point. Her kind, empathetic and loving nature abounds. Hannah is a truly wonderful adoption candidate.

She enjoys her time in the car and walks nicely on her lead. Hannah seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Tamsin
description:
Our extra special girl Tamsin is approximately two years old and the most beautiful mixed breed with something of a hound appearance.

Tamsin weighs a delightful thirteen kilos and measures fifteen inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets, Tamsin has been in our Cyprus shelter for three months.

Our shelter manager reports that Tamsin has the sweetest and calm personality, and she thoroughly enjoys walking on the lead where her behaviour is exemplary.

Tamsin has a wonderful personality and exudes kindness and empathy. She thoroughly enjoys her time with her human companions and shares happiness and affection.

Tamsin is absolutely beautiful with her rich tan and black coat, puppy dog eyes, striking ears and a near perpetual smile. Film star quality looks to say the very least. Tamsin is the ideal adoption candidate who is ready made for a kind and loving family.

Tamsin enjoys her time in the car and seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats, kittens, children and donkeys.

name: Serena
description:
*** SERENA WILL COME TO FOSTER IN BANSTEAD, SURREY, ON 1ST NOVEMBER 2026 ***

Our extra special girl Serena is approximately two years old and a medium sized cross breed perhaps with something of a hound content.

Serena weighs thirteen kilos and measures ten inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets, Serena has been in our Cyprus shelter for around four months.

Our shelter manager describes Serena as very sweet and she has an exceptionally loving personality. Serena enjoys amazing eye contact with her favourite human and constantly wins numerous hearts.

Her sandy coat is beautifully enhanced with a white flash to her chest along with four white toe tips. Her ears are gorgeous and probably award winning, leaving Serena as visually stunning.

Serena is the ideal adoption candidate and will make a perfect addition to her forever family. She is so deserving.

Serena enjoys her time in the car and walks nicely on her lead. She also seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Lily
description:
Our extra special girl Lily is approximately six years old and a near perfect cross breed at the bottom end of medium sized. Lily weighs just fourteen kilos and measures fourteen inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been found on the streets Lily has been in our Cyprus shelter for one month.

Our shelter manager reports that Lily is very timid and needs lots of reassurance. She is quiet, very sweet and walks beautifully on her lead. Which begs the question: what more does a girl have to do?

Lily is so attractive with her shining black coat and delicate features. Her gorgeous eyes are perfectly enhanced with her prize-winning ears and sublime expressions.

A very discerning adopting family will recognise the prize that Lily represents. She will be so grateful to join a quiet family in an orderly house with a steady routine. Paradise for all concerned.

Lily seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Lasi
description:
Our extra special girl Lasi is approximately two years old and a very splendid cross breed at the bottom end of medium. Lasi weighs just fourteen kilos and measures twelve inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been found abandoned on the streets, Lasi has been in our Cyprus shelter for four months.

Lasi has been described by our shelter manager as calm, sweet, eager to please and will make a fabulous family dog.

Her appearance is breathtaking with a light tan coat and a graduated darker tan along her back. Gorgeous hazel eyes and beautiful ears are showstoppers.

Lasi will fit into her forever home so well and will bring years of joy and happiness to her very fortunate adopters.

Lasi walks nicely on her lead and enjoys her time in the car. She seems to mix perfectly well with children, cats and other dogs.

name: Fenton
description:
Fenton, is we believe, between eighteen months and two years old and a wire-haired pointer or thereabouts.

Fenton has been in our Cyprus Shelter for just a couple of months, having been found abandoned on the streets.

Fenton sounds like he would make a wonderful addition to any family!

His relaxed demeanour and easy-going nature make him an excellent candidate for adoption.

His ability to get along well with other animals and children also makes him very adaptable to different household environments.

He is strikingly good-looking and a handsome boy with his black, grey and brindle coat.

It is great to hear that Fenton walks nicely on a lead as this suggests he is open to training and willing to please.

As Fenton is still relatively young, he is likely has plenty of energy for walks and playtime, but he will also appreciate some quiet time for relaxation.

Overall, it sounds like Fenton has a lot to offer to a lucky family or individual.

With his friendly disposition and adaptability, he is sure to bring joy and companionship wherever he goes.

Please open your heart and give Fenton his forever home where he can be loved and cherished.

name: Cade
description:
Cade is a 1 year old male Sharpei Cross. His current weight is 29kg.

Cade is looking for a new home where he’ll be very much involved in what’s going on.

Cade is very enthusiastic when meeting new people and can be overwhelming for some.

A family experienced in handling dogs is preferred.

Cade is very sociable around other dogs and can live with a dog-savvy cat.

Due to his “bull in a china shop” manner, a home with no children is preferred, although Cade can live with teenagers.

He is crate trained and sees the crate as his time to chill.

Cade isn’t used to being left alone and has always had the company of other dogs, so this will need to be gradually built up in his new home.

Cade is very food-driven, which benefits his training.

All applicants must live within 1 hours drive from Upminster Essex.

name: Peck
description:
Peck is a 3-4-month-old male cross breed, discovered alongside his brother Greg, abandoned near the shelter in Lousã, central Portugal.

These poor pups were rescued, underweight and frightened, and have since received nourishment and tender care, transforming into healthy and vibrant little companions eager to find their forever homes.

While the exact breed remains uncertain, there’s a suggestion of Portuguese Podengo in Peck and Greg, anticipating a small to medium size when fully grown.

Despite their challenging start in life, Peck, though initially timid, readily places trust in humans and exhibits confidence around other dogs.

He currently shares a kennel with three other puppies, demonstrating his sociable nature. Peck has shown positive responsiveness to harness training, allowing for easy lead walks.

He holds great potential to become a delightful companion, provided with the dedication and training that a young pup requires.

As part of the adoption process, Peck has been chipped, vaccinated, and health-tested, ensuring his readiness for a new home.

The adoption fee of £450 covers not only Peck’s well-being but also includes transport to the UK through a reputable company, comprehensive foster support, and the necessary vaccinations for the journey.

name: Greg
description:
Greg is a 3-4-month-old male cross breed currently residing in Lousã, central Portugal. Found abandoned along with his brother Peck near a shelter, these two pups were in dire straits – alone, scared, and emaciated.

Thanks to the care they received, both Peck and Greg have made remarkable recoveries and are now healthy little pups eagerly awaiting their forever homes.

While the exact breed of these pups remains uncertain, there’s a hint of Portuguese Podengo in their lineage, and they are expected to be small to medium-sized when fully grown.

Greg, in particular, showcases a timid demeanor owing to early mistreatment, but he readily places his trust in humans. His confidence shines through when interacting with other dogs, as he shares a kennel with three other puppies.

Recently introduced to harnesses and leads, Greg is already adapting well and is poised to become an ideal companion for someone willing to invest time and effort into a puppy’s training.

As part of the adoption process, Greg has undergone essential procedures like microchipping, vaccination, and health testing.

The adoption fee for Greg is £450, covering not only these medical necessities but also the cost of transportation to the UK facilitated by a reputable company. Adopters can be assured of full foster backup, ensuring a smooth transition for Greg into his new home.

name: Milo
description:
Milo is an 8-year-old male Mioritic shepherd cross, measuring 56cm in height, residing in Romania.

Rescued from a public shelter, Milo’s heart longs for a loving home where he can spend his remaining years.

Despite his size, he possesses a gentle heart and hopes to find someone special to share his life with.

Currently staying in a private shelter, Milo awaits the day someone chooses him to be part of their family.

He seeks an experienced home capable of caring for big dogs like him, preferably with knowledge of Mioritic breeds.

Transitioning to a new environment, Milo will need time to decompress and adjust, making patience and kindness essential qualities in his future owners.

A secure garden would be ideal for him to play and explore safely, fulfilling his desire for outdoor activities.

On the medical front, Milo is fully vaccinated, blood tested, and has received flea and worm treatments.

He is also neutered, microchipped, and registered in the Recs system.

Milo is prepared for travel to the U.K. with his own passport and import papers, though he understands the journey will take time.

name: Beau
description:
Beau is a 3.5-year-old male cross-breed. He is a wonderful and calm dog, longing for a home where he can feel loved and secure.

Rescued from a public shelter in Romania, Beau currently resides in a private shelter, where he has shown himself to be a calm and gentle character.

Weighing 18kg, Beau is vaccinated, blood tested, flead, wormed, neutered, and microchipped. His thick coat and beautiful black button nose add to his charm.

Despite his past, Beau interacts well with everyone in the shelter and lives peacefully with two males and a female dog in his kennel.

Beau has met older children, specifically teenagers, and has shown a calm and gentle demeanour around them. He has no allergies or intolerances and does not require any regular medications.

An ideal home for Beau would be one with dog-experienced owners who can provide a secure garden for him to explore. The household should be calm, kind, and patient, with older children aged 14 and above.

Although Beau is calm and gentle, he needs support with lead training, house training, and continued socialising. It is important to note that Beau is not suitable to live with cats.

Beau’s potential new family will need to go through the application and checks process with Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

This ensures that Beau will be placed in a suitable environment where he can thrive and be happy.

name: Kalea
description:
Kalea, a lovely and calm girl, is rescued from a distressing public shelter in Romania.

Approximately 6 years old, Kalea has been thriving in a private foster home for over a year, enjoying the care and attention she deserves.

Walking nicely on a lead, Kalea has adapted well to both female and male caregivers. In good health, she boasts no known allergies or intolerances. She is spayed, vaccinated, blood-tested, flea, and worm-treated, and microchipped, ensuring she is ready for her forever home.

In her quest for the perfect home, Kalea is looking for a calm and friendly environment, ideally with individuals who are rescue dog-savvy. She could happily coexist with another dog, and older children aged 14 and above, provided they are dog-savvy as well.

A secure garden is on her wishlist, creating a safe space for her to enjoy.

Kalea thrives in a home that isn’t too bustling with constant comings and goings, seeking a haven that provides love, compassion, and safety. Her potential adopters are urged to be prepared to go above and beyond to meet the needs of a rescue dog.

Recognizing the considerable journey these dogs undertake to find a home, it’s crucial to afford them the time they need to decompress, which may extend to days or even weeks.

The adoption process for Kalea involves an application and checks, ensuring that her potential adopters are committed to providing the care, understanding, and patience required for a dog with a challenging past.

For those ready to open their hearts and homes to Kalea, the reward will be the companionship and gratitude of a soul on its journey to a brighter future.

name: Twix
description:
Twix is a small, approximately 1-2-year-old female Cross-Breed currently in Romania, seeking a loving family.

Vaccinated and spayed, Twix is microchipped and ready for adoption.

She was abandoned and found roaming the streets, highlighting her need for a stable and caring home where she will be cherished forever.

Twix is described as friendly and gets along well with both people and other dogs, making her a good fit for a family environment.

She is suitable for children aged 8 and above, indicating she can adapt well to a household with older kids.

In terms of training, Twix will benefit from support with housetraining and ongoing positive reinforcement to help her settle into her new home smoothly.

She has no known allergies or intolerances and does not require any medication at present.

Currently under the care of Rbu – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK, Twix’s adoption process will involve an application and necessary checks to ensure she finds a suitable and loving forever home.

name: Lola
description:
Meet Lola, a bundle of squishy love at approximately 7 months old, captured in all her playful glory in the picture below. Lola is a loving, active, and spirited pup who delights in running, jumping, and playing throughout the day.

Her exuberance is contagious, but it’s important to note that Lola can get quite excited and jump up, making her more suitable for a home without small children.

In search of an experienced and active home, Lola thrives on interaction and companionship, preferring not to be left alone for extended periods.

Having been abandoned by her sisters when she was tiny, Lola has yet to experience life in a house, making her journey to a forever home a special one that requires patience and positive guidance.

Lola, a Croatian hunting dog mix, would appreciate a home without little furries to chase. She has no reservations about men or women and can coexist with dog-savvy children aged 16 and above.

Described by her carers as confident, friendly, and comfortable with other dogs and visitors, Lola is a joy to have around. She walks well on a lead and cherishes moments of cuddling.

Currently residing in Croatia, Lola is ready to embark on a new chapter of her life in the UK through Rescue Backup (RBU). Vaccinated, blood-tested, flea, and worm-treated, and microchipped, Lola is well-prepared for the journey.

If you’re ready to welcome Lola into your heart and home, an application and checks are part of the process, ensuring a harmonious match between Lola and her future family.

name: Julie
description:
Julie is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed, medium/small in size, currently located in Romania.

She was abandoned in a cardboard box along with 4 newborns on the sidewalk of a road in the town of Tecuci in Romania on 25/05/2024.

A lady asked for help with them, and although we already have a lot of animals in care, we couldn’t bear to leave them there.

Julie is a perfect mother, caring and affectionate. She has a very gentle, kind, and submissive character; she likes to be cuddled and petted.

She can live, after a gradual introduction, with other dogs and children aged 10+. Unfortunately, there is not enough information about how she interacts with cats.

Adopting a dog is a very big decision, so please make sure you are ready for the challenge and commitment.

Are you ready to take care of her? Pay her vet bills? Feed her? Walk her? Consider her a family member for the rest of her life?

If so, we’d love to hear from you! RBU – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

name: Bleki
description:
Introducing Bleki, a delightful female dog awaiting her forever home.

At 2 years old, Bleki is a beautiful Lab/Hound cross currently residing in Bosnia. Despite her past, Bleki is in excellent health and has been fully vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and spayed.

Bleki’s loving personality has won over the hearts of everyone at the shelter where she resides. Known for her easygoing nature and calm demeanor, Bleki serves as a positive influence on her more energetic companions.

She exudes confidence and affection, readily seeking out cuddles and enjoying being groomed and stroked.

Bleki is well-behaved on the lead and thoroughly enjoys her walks, where she can indulge in the joy of exploration. She gets along well with other dogs and is good with children.

However, she has not been tested with cats. Bleki’s ideal home would provide her with plenty of love, attention, and opportunities for outdoor adventures.

Please note that upon arrival in the UK, Bosnian dogs such as Bleki are required to quarantine in UK kennels for 48 hours before being able to join their new families.

If you’re interested in providing Bleki with the loving home she deserves, please submit an application through Rbu- Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK. Application and checks are part of the adoption process to ensure Bleki finds the perfect match.

name: Medena
description:
Medena, a stunning female dog, is looking for her forever home. Estimated to be around 1-2 years old, Medena is of medium size and boasts a cross breed heritage.

Her current residence is in Bosnia, but she dreams of finding a loving family to explore the world with. Despite her beauty, Medena’s exuberant personality makes her better suited to homes with children aged 13 and above, and she has not been tested with cats.

At the shelter, Medena stands out as one of the most beautiful dogs, and she certainly knows it! She thrives on attention and is at her happiest when she’s out of her kennel, whether it’s for a walk or playtime.

With her intelligence and quick learning ability, Medena is eager to please and would benefit from continued training in a loving home environment.

Medena’s ideal home would provide her with the guidance of a confident older dog and owners committed to continuing her training.

Managing her arousal levels and ensuring she receives plenty of exercise and mental stimulation are crucial for her well-being. Vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and spayed, Medena is ready to embark on her new life adventure.

Upon arrival in the UK, Medena, like other Bosnian dogs, will need to quarantine in UK kennels for 48 hours before joining her new family.

If you believe you can offer Medena the loving and supportive home she deserves, please consider submitting an application through Rbu – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

Application and checks are necessary steps in the adoption process to ensure Medena finds the perfect match.

name: Frodo
description:
Frodo, a male crossbreed dog of approximately 1-2 years old, is eagerly searching for his forever home.

This medium-sized cross breed pup, currently residing in Bosnia, is known for his gentle and placid nature. Despite not being cat-tested, Frodo loves the company of other dogs and is excellent with calm and sensible children.

At the shelter, Frodo is a beloved favorite, often found curled up under the desk in the office, seeking affection from shelter staff. He enjoys strokes, cuddles, and the companionship of both humans and fellow canines.

Although he may initially be nervous, especially since he has spent most of his life in the shelter, Frodo quickly gains confidence with love and attention. Once he forms a bond with you, he becomes your loyal and affectionate best friend.

Frodo is described as affectionate, loyal, and eager to please. He is making great progress with his training and is keen to learn and adapt to his new environment.

Fully vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, neutered, and microchipped, Frodo is ready to embark on his new life adventure.

Upon arrival in the UK, Frodo, like other Bosnian dogs, will need to quarantine in UK kennels for 48 hours before joining his new family.

If you’re interested in giving Frodo the loving home he deserves, please consider submitting an application through Rbu – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

Application and checks are part of the adoption process to ensure Frodo finds the perfect match.

name: Snoopy
description:
Snoopy, a charming male Hound Cross puppy of just 3 months old, is eagerly seeking a loving family to call his own.

This medium-sized Hound cross was found abandoned in the bushes and brought to the shelter, but despite his rocky start, Snoopy’s happy-go-lucky nature shines through.

Lonely in the shelter, Snoopy longs for companionship and a warm home environment where he can thrive.

Despite his young age, Snoopy exudes confidence and affection.

He adores playtime, with tug being his favorite game, and he eagerly interacts with other dogs and people alike.

Snoopy’s loving nature extends to children, and he is currently working on being calm around them. As he is still in the early stages of his life, Snoopy is open to being socialized with cats at the shelter.

Snoopy’s delightful personality makes him an ideal addition to any loving home. He is vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, and microchipped, with neutering pending due to his age.

Upon arrival in the UK, Snoopy, like other Bosnian dogs, will need to quarantine in UK kennels for 48 hours before joining his new family.

If you’re ready to open your heart and home to Snoopy, please consider submitting an application through Rbu – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

Application and checks are part of the adoption process to ensure Snoopy finds the perfect match.

name: Bianka
description:
Bianka, a delightful female cross breed dog of approximately 1 year old, is eagerly seeking her forever home.

This medium-sized sweetheart, currently located in Bosnia, has a charming and playful nature that captures the hearts of everyone she meets.

Bianka’s playful spirit ensures she’s always in the midst of any fun happening at the shelter, enthusiastically engaging with her friends and toys alike.

Although initially shy around strangers, Bianka transforms into a confident and affectionate companion once she’s out of her kennel.

She thrives in the company of other dogs and children, showcasing her adaptability and gentle nature.

Bianka’s potential shines brightest in a loving home environment, where she can continue to blossom with the support of another dog and ongoing training to build her confidence.

Fully vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, spayed, and microchipped, Bianka is ready to embark on her new life journey.

If you’re ready to provide Bianka with the loving and nurturing home she deserves, please consider submitting an application through Rbu – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

Application and checks are part of the adoption process to ensure Bianka finds the perfect match.

name: Monty
description:
Meet Monty, a 4 year old male Sighthound who is outstanding and extremely friendly!

Monty has experienced unimaginable suffering but still forgives so much. He is looking for a wonderful and loving home.

Monty was saved from a private shelter where he received no medical treatment and little food.

It was discovered that Monty had suffered blunt trauma to his eye. Now residing in a private shelter run by a local vet in Romania, Monty is ready to find his forever home.

Monty is human-orientated, loves people, and craves human touch and contact.

He is active, playful, and a pure delight to be around. Monty shows no fear of veterinary procedures and has displayed no aggression toward carers, vets, or visitors. He is absolutely desperate for love.

Monty can live with older dog-savvy children and needs an experienced dog owner.

He requires a secure garden with 6ft fencing for play and training. A home without cats or small furries is preferable, as Monty will chase them.

Monty has been thoroughly vet-checked, and while he has a non-functional left eye, it does not cause him pain. There is a potential risk of future complications, but surgery is not recommended at this time.

Anyone who opens up their home to Monty will be truly blessed. He is a beautiful and kind-natured dog who will settle easily into a home environment.

name: Abbie
description:
Abbie, a 3-year-old female cross-breed dog, hails from Romania, having been rescued from the Lancram shelter.

Despite her challenging beginnings, Abbie now resides in a private foster home, eagerly awaiting the opportunity to join a loving family. This small-sized cross breed, standing at 40cm in height, is adored for her sweet and kind nature.

Known for her infectious smile and enthusiastically wagging tail, Abbie thrives on human interaction and affection.

Abbie has been described as lead trained and exhibits no known allergies or intolerances. Despite her underbite, which does not cause her discomfort, she maintains a healthy appetite and enjoys normal eating and drinking habits.

Regular dental care is recommended to ensure her oral hygiene remains in good condition. Remarkably, Abbie shares her foster home with a cat and has shown no inclination towards chasing or bothering her feline companion, demonstrating her peaceful nature and adaptability.

For those interested in adopting Abbie, applications and checks are facilitated through Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

With her endearing personality and gentle demeanour, Abbie promises to bring joy and companionship to her future forever family.

name: Conor
description:
Conor is a 3-year-old male Beagle cross Hound. This gorgeous boy weighs around 25kg and has a gentle, soulful expression that perfectly matches his kind nature.

Conor’s story started out rough — he was found wandering the streets before being taken to a pound in Galicia, Northern Spain. Sadly, he spent nearly 12 months in one of the toughest pounds in the country.

Despite that, his spirit remained unbroken, and now he’s safe in residence near Lugo, finally getting the care and kindness he deserves.

He’s a handsome hound mix who’s healthy, active, and ready for a new start. Conor is friendly with people, though a little shy when meeting new faces.

Once he feels safe, he quickly warms up and shows his affectionate, relaxed side. He’s wonderful with other dogs, enjoying playtime and socialising, and he’s been cat tested — with great results. This shows what a gentle and adaptable dog he truly is.

Conor loves being outdoors, whether he’s exploring on walks or simply enjoying fresh air in a secure garden. A secure space is essential for his safety and comfort as he continues adjusting to home life.

He’s fully neutered, vaccinated (including rabies), microchipped, and has had comprehensive blood tests for Mediterranean diseases and brucellosis.

Conor also comes with a passport and full rescue backup. Transport can be arranged anywhere in the UK, so this sweet boy can start his next chapter wherever his perfect family may be.

name: Paddy
description:
Paddy is an 8-month-old male Cross-Breed. He’s one of Bea’s five adorable puppies and has already shown himself to be a gentle and sweet-natured boy.

Despite being a little hand-shy, Paddy’s personality shines through—he just needs some time, patience, and love to help his confidence blossom.

Like many pups, Paddy is still learning about the world around him. His gentle temperament suggests he’ll grow into a loyal and affectionate companion once he settles into a secure and loving home.

He’s expected to be medium-sized when fully grown, making him the perfect balance between playful energy and easy manageability.

Currently, Paddy is in Romania, waiting eagerly for his chance to travel to the UK. With winter quickly approaching, rescuers are hoping to find him a home before the cold truly sets in.

Paddy has been fully vaccinated and blood tested, so he’s ready for his next big adventure—a forever home of his own.

Pennypaws Rescue will provide full rescue back-up and ongoing support to make sure Paddy and his future family have everything they need for a smooth transition.

A video homecheck will be required, ensuring that Paddy finds a safe, warm place where he can grow up feeling loved and secure.

name: Toto
description:
Meet Toto – A Little Fighter with a Big Heart!

Some dogs have to overcome so much before they get the chance to enjoy the happy life they deserve.

Little Toto, 1 year old male Cross-Breed, is one of them. This adorable boy is a true survivor who has battled not one, but two serious illnesses – parvovirus and coronavirus.

His journey has been far from easy, but Toto has shown just how much of a fighter he really is.

A Little About Toto Toto spent almost two months in hospital receiving treatment as he fought these terrible illnesses, one after the other.

At his lowest point, he weighed just 3kg and was little more than skin and bones. His recovery took time, patience and an incredible amount of care, but thankfully Toto pulled through.

He has regained his strength, his smile has returned and he is finally able to look forward to a much brighter future.

Toto has now travelled to the UK and is safely with us at Saving and Rehoming Strays in Ayr, waiting for the loving home he so thoroughly deserves.

Friends of All Kinds! Despite everything he has been through, Toto is an extremely sociable little boy. He gets along wonderfully with other dogs, regardless of their size or gender, and absolutely loves cats too!

He’s a friendly, affectionate little character who enjoys being around others and is happiest when he has company.

Little Things Make Toto Happy Toto is a boy who appreciates the comforts in life! He adores soft, fluffy beds, cosy places to snuggle, cuddles and affection.

He loves spending time with people and other animals and is used to walking on a lead, so he already has a good start when it comes to heading out for adventures with his new family.

Yes – Dogs: Excellent with dogs of all sizes and genders

Medical history Recovered from parvovirus and coronavirus following extensive veterinary treatment.

Could You Give Toto His Happy Ever After?

After everything this little boy has overcome, we want his next chapter to be full of love, comfort and happiness.

Toto has fought incredibly hard for his second chance. Now he needs a family who will spoil him with cuddles, provide plenty of cosy beds and show him that life really can be wonderful.

If you’re looking for a small, sociable and affectionate companion who loves people, dogs and cats, Toto could be just the boy for you!

A home check and adoption donation apply. Potential adopters must be willing to travel to Ayr to meet and collect Toto

name: Max
description:
Meet Max – A Gentle Soul Looking for His Forever Home

Some dogs come into rescue with a story that breaks your heart, and Max, 4 year old male Cross-Breed, is one of them. But despite everything he has been through, this lovely boy has held on to his gentle nature and his trust in people.

Max was found abandoned in a mountainous tourist area, covered in wounds and wearing nothing more than a red collar. He had no microchip and, sadly, nobody came forward to look for him.

We will never know what happened in Max’s past or why he was abandoned. What we do know is that he is an incredibly gentle, well-mannered boy who deserves so much better.

A Little About Max Before travelling to the UK

Max was living in a foster home in an apartment.

His behaviour was so calm and impeccable from the very beginning that his foster family actually wondered whether something might be wrong with him!

He was taken for a full veterinary health check, and every result came back perfectly normal.

There was nothing wrong with Max at all. He was simply a quiet, gentle boy who seemed grateful to have a warm, safe place to call home.

Max has now travelled to the UK and is safely with us at Saving and Rehoming Strays in Ayr, where he is waiting for someone to offer him the forever home he deserves.

He is a wonderfully easy-going character who doesn’t bark unnecessarily, make a fuss or destroy things. He enjoys a peaceful life and, above all, loves being around people.

Friends of All Kinds Max gets along beautifully with both dogs and cats, making him a lovely candidate for a home with existing pets.

His gentle nature and easy-going personality mean we believe he could adapt to a variety of home environments, provided he has the love, companionship and security he needs.

What Home Would Suit Max? Max isn’t looking for anything complicated.

He simply wants a loving home where he can feel safe, enjoy human company and be part of the family. We would love to find him

A kind, loving family who will cherish him. – A home where he can enjoy plenty of human companionship. – A peaceful environment where he can relax and feel secure. – Potentially a home with other friendly dogs or cats.

Dogs: Gets along beautifully with other dogs

Health: Full veterinary tests before travelling were reported as normal.

Could You Give Max His Happy Ever After? Max has already been let down once in his life. We want his next chapter to be filled with kindness, comfort and the security of a family who will never abandon him.

He is a gentle, affectionate soul who asks for very little but has so much love to give. Could you be the person who shows him what it means to have a forever home? Please get in touch if you think Max could be the missing piece in your family.

A home check and adoption donation apply. Potential adopters must be willing to travel to Ayr to meet and collect Max.

name: Pipo
description:
Meet Pipo – A Happy Little Boy with Lots of Love to Give!

Sometimes the dogs who need us most are the ones who have been misunderstood. Little Pipo, 1 year old male Cross-Breed, is one of those dogs, and his story could have been very different if someone hadn’t stopped to give him a chance.

Pipo was discovered in a public shelter, desperately trying to get someone’s attention.

He was climbing up the fence and crying, clearly distressed and unhappy with his situation. When our rescue partner asked why he was there, she was initially told that he had bitten a child.

However, on questioning further, she was told that he had actually scratched a child. Rather than walk away, she decided to take Pipo out of the shelter and give him the opportunity he deserved. And what a lovely little boy he turned out to be!

A Little About Pipo Our rescue partner describes Pipo as an absolutely wonderful, loving dog.

He’s playful, affectionate, sociable and full of life. Since leaving the public shelter, he has shown himself to be a very friendly and happy little character.

He has lived with other dogs, previously sharing his space with Chip and now living alongside another male dog

He gets along beautifully with them, and his foster family have experienced no problems.

Our partner has never witnessed any signs of aggression from Pipo towards people or other dogs. He’s a boy who clearly enjoys company and has so much affection to give. Pipo has now travelled to the UK and is safely with us at Saving and Rehoming Strays in Ayr, where he’s waiting for a family to offer him his forever home.

Friends and Family Pipo is very sociable with other dogs and has happily shared his living space with male companions. He’s also met our rescue partner’s young daughter, Alice, and was extremely friendly towards her.

However, we do need to be open about the information provided when Pipo was originally taken into the public shelter.

Although the initial report was that he had bitten a child, this was later clarified as a scratch. Our rescue partner has never witnessed any aggression from him and cannot establish exactly what happened.

Out of an abundance of caution, we feel Pipo would be best suited to a home without young children.

We would rather be completely transparent and make sure his next home is the right one for everyone. We haven’t had the opportunity to assess Pipo around cats, so we cannot confirm how he would react to them.

Pipo would love a home where he can enjoy being part of the family, have plenty of company and receive all the affection he clearly adores.

We believe he could potentially live with another friendly dog, given how well he has got along with his current canine companions. A home with older, sensible children may be worth considering, but his ideal home would be one without young children.

Dogs: Gets along beautifully with other dogs

Children: Has been friendly with a child, but a home without young children is recommended as a precaution

Personality: Playful, affectionate, sociable and full of life

Could You Give Pipo His Happy Ever After? Pipo’s story started with a very unhappy chapter, but thanks to someone who was willing to look beyond what they had been told, he got his second chance.

He’s now safely in the UK and ready to find the family who will love him for the happy, affectionate little boy he is.

If you can offer Pipo a loving home, plenty of companionship and the chance to enjoy all the good things life has to offer, we’d love to hear from you.

A home check and adoption donation apply. Potential adopters must be willing to travel to Ayr to meet and collect Pipo.

name: Dudley
description:
Meet Dudley – A Big, Affectionate Boy Looking for a Home of His Own

Sometimes, despite everyone’s best efforts, a home just isn’t the right fit for a dog any longer. Dudley, 4 year old male Cross-Breed, is a much-loved boy whose family are sadly looking for a new home where he can enjoy all the love and attention he deserves.

Dudley is a big, handsome boy with a wonderfully affectionate nature.

He loves people, fuss and cuddles, and his family describe him as a lovely dog who simply wants to be loved.

They are heartbroken to be looking for a new home for him, but want to make sure his next chapter is the right one.

A Little About Dudley Dudley is friendly with everyone and has always been happy to welcome visitors into his home.

He’s an affectionate boy who enjoys spending time with his people and would happily choose a comfortable sofa over a busy day of activities!

He enjoys his walks and being outdoors, although he doesn’t need endless exercise and is quite content with shorter walks when that’s what’s possible.

He has some wonderfully playful habits too – he absolutely loves snow and piles of autumn leaves, burying himself in them and rolling around!

He’s happy sleeping in a crate at night and will sometimes choose to relax in it during the day, although the sofa is definitely his preferred spot.

Dudley isn’t particularly interested in toys or balls, but he does enjoy his food, biscuits and chews.

He’s not known to chew furniture or household belongings.

The Home Dudley Needs Dudley’s recent experiences mean we need to be very careful about finding the right home for him.

Dudley cannot be in a home with cats or small furry animals and although he has previously lived with other dogs, we feel it is now in Dudley’s best interests to find a home where he can be the only pet.

Dudleys family say that when out in a park, he will happily ignore other dogs. We are looking for:

1. A home where Dudley can be the only pet.

3. A family who can provide plenty of affection, companionship and sensible boundaries.

4. A home without young children. Dudley has happily lived with children from the age of seven, but he can jump up when excited, so older, dog-savvy children would be more appropriate.

5. Someone confident handling a large, strong dog on walks.

Walking and Training Dudley loves going out for walks.

He can pull initially when excited but generally settles as the walk progresses. However, he can be very strong if he spots something small and furry, particularly rabbits and squirrels!

Dudley has always been kept on lead and his family use a figure-of-eight lead, which he is comfortable wearing and which helps with control.

He has had some training with a trainer who visited the family home when he was a puppy. He can also become reactive towards dogs travelling past on quad bikes, pulling and barking at them.

His new family will need to understand these behaviours and be prepared to manage his walks carefully and continue working on his training.

6. Children: Has lived happily with children from age seven

7. Dogs: Has lived with other dogs, but needs to be the only pet

8. Cats and small furries: Not safe – will attack

9. Walking: Must remain on lead due to prey drive

A Message From His Family “We love him to bits and want a good home for him. He really is a lovely boy, but I think he needs to be the only pet in a household. He deserves and wants so much love.”

Could You Offer Dudley the Home He Needs? Dudley is a much-loved family dog who deserves a happy future. We would ideally love to find him the right home directly from his current family, avoiding the need for him to come back into rescue.

His family are based near Hexham in Northumberland and are hoping to find someone who can offer him the time, affection and understanding he needs.

If you think you could offer Dudley a suitable home, please get in touch with us. We would love to help find this lovely boy the fresh start he deserves.

Please note: 1. A home check and adoption donation will apply. 2. Potential adopters must be able to travel to Dudley’s home near Hexham, Northumberland, to meet and collect him.

name: Lonzo
description:
Poor Lonzo, an 18 month old male Labrador Retriever Cross, hasn’t had the best run of luck since arriving in the UK.

His first home felt he was too bouncy for their young son, and now sadly his second home feel they can’t offer him the kind of lifestyle he truly needs.

Lonzo is, and has always been, a silly, goofy boy with a big personality, no understanding of personal space or his size, and a boisterous (but innocent) play style. He’s looking for an active home that can give him all the fun and fuss he’s desperate for.

Lonzo was found without a collar or microchip, wandering the outskirts of Nicosia in Cyprus earlier this year, looking for food and water.

He is estimated to be around 1-2 years old, so still quite a young dog who definitely needs some focus and continued training in a new home.

He absolutely loves people and believes everyone is his bestie. He loves any kind of attention and is a very sociable boy who loves to please people.

Although Lonzo is currently living as the only resident dog, he would benefit from a settled resident dog to learn from.

He was always very adaptable to new kennel mates in Cyprus, and has attended daycare in the UK where he was a very friendly boy towards everyone.

A resident dog would be great for him to learn some manners, to settle at home, and simply to have a best friend to play with too.

Lonzo’s foster family describe him as funny, very friendly, and a little bit dopey! He loves his bed, is a sucker for a belly rub, and just wants to be involved in everything.

He is an excitable, enthusiastic boy and can be quite jumpy, but he doesn’t mean to cause any bother – he is just always on a mission to make new friends.

Because of this, we think he would be better suited to a home with children aged 10+ so he doesn’t knock anyone over, as he is a strong dog.

Lonzo is still getting to grips with lead training, and gets very excited to go outside. After around 15 minutes he really calms down and walks well on the lead, so it will just take a bit of continued training and consistency.

On walks he is happy to say hello to anyone and everyone, dogs and people.

Lonzo is looking for a semi-rural home with a garden and an active lifestyle. He would prefer an away from busy roads and lots of noise, and wouldn’t enjoy being left at home alone for extended periods of time.

He very much wants to be involved and in good company, as he’s people oriented, and he loves being outdoors, exploring, sniffing and chasing birds and squirrels. He is also a water baby and loves to splash about!

Lonzo is a fantastic character and anyone who adopts him will be very lucky to welcome him into the family. He is big and bouncy, but also has a huge heart and such a willingness to learn.

He’s smart, incredibly loyal, and will truly make the best friend given the opportunity.

name: Bowie
description:
Bowie is a 5-year-old male Cross-Breed. He is an affectionate big dog full of love and is craving human care.

This sweet boy has been waiting for a while to find his forever home. Bowie is neutered, fully vaccinated, and microchipped, making him a well-prepared companion for a new family.

He weighs between 32 kg and 35 kg and stands about 52 cm tall, making him a large dog with a gentle personality.

Bowie currently resides in a run with another dog but could also thrive as an only dog in the right home.

His loving nature makes him well-suited to live with a couple, an individual, or potentially a family with older children. He seeks companionship and affection and would benefit from being in a home where he can receive the care and attention he craves.

Bowie has waited for a long time to find his special person, and he would love nothing more than to settle into a home where he can be loved for life.

The rescue offers lifetime support to ensure Bowie transitions smoothly into his new home. His calm, affectionate nature makes him a great fit for someone looking for a loyal and loving companion.

He is ready to bring joy to a family or individual who can provide the space, care, and affection he needs.

name: Stevie
description:
Stevie is a 1 year old male Cross-Breed. This young fellow was abandoned with others and has been taken into foster with an English lady in Romania.

He is living with other pups and a surrogate mum and dad dog, so he is getting lots of doggy socialising.

Stevie has never lived in a house, but most of our dogs adapt quite quickly.

It is very hot over there at the moment, so the dogs tend to stay in their shelters, but we managed to get a few photos of this good-looking chap.

He will be a medium-sized adult and would love a doggy friend to teach him the ropes.

He will be fully vaccinated, wormed, and given flea treatment before he travels.

All our dogs have pet passports which contain all of their medical interventions.

Hopefully, we will be able to neuter him before he travels. He will travel by van directly to see his new adopter in the UK.

name: Mischa
description:
Mischa is a shy and reserved girl who, along with her sister Raina, was thrown over the wall of a kennels in November 2024 when they were only young pups. At around eight months old now, Mischa will be a large-sized adult dog, but she is a complete softie.

Mischa and Raina were abandoned in the right place with the right people. For the first few weeks, they were glued to each other, but as they’ve become more settled, they are becoming braver and coming into their own personalities.

Mischa tends to hang back while Raina takes the lead, but she’s improving each day. Routine and consistency will be key in helping her feel settled in a new home. She’s gentle, sweet, and soft, just needing reassurance and confidence building to blossom into a confident dog.

When it comes to other dogs, Mischa is very playful and enjoys interacting with her sister and other kennel dogs. She loves playing in the paddock and has bursts of speed, often being chased by Raina.

Mischa would be best suited to a semi-rural home with a calm household atmosphere and a moderately active lifestyle. She needs a garden and a resident dog to help her adjust to a companion lifestyle.

Mischa is currently based in Cyprus, has a clean bill of health, and is ready to travel to her forever home.

name: Albi
description:
ALBI – A War Hero Who Found His Smile Again: A New Dog in a New Life. ALBI is a Ukraine war dog in need of a safe haven. Available under a foster-to-adopt. Adoption fee significantly reduced

Meet ALBI, a 9 -year-old small-sized corgi type. ALBI once walked the front lines of war, shoulder-to-shoulder with Ukrainian soldiers. But in the UK, we misunderstood him terribly.

We thought he needed peace and quiet. We placed him with elderly people, in silent homes with no other pets. But he was miserable. He was misunderstood, unhappy, and reactive—trying to tell us something we failed to hear.

Then something beautiful happened. When ALBI was just days away from being sent to kennels, a wonderful foster stepped in—and everything changed.

Now living in an active household with children and dogs, ALBI is a completely different dog. His foster says:

“He’s the most perfect dog I’ve ever met. Kind, loving, grateful. He adores being part of the action—bonfires, walks, games, relaxing by your side—he just wants to be included.”

“He loves kids—especially calm, dog-savvy ones—and he adores other dogs. Even shy or reactive dogs feel safe with him because he reads them so well and gives them space. He’s playful, gentle, and so grateful for every moment. Even visitors don’t upset him anymore—he’s just relaxed and joyful.”

ALBI has finally shown us who he really is. This is his fresh start. And now he needs the right home to match.

Rescue StoryALBI is a war survivor. He lived with soldiers in trenches under shelling—eating scraps, keeping watch, offering comfort. They described him as the “most loyal companion” they’d known. After the war, he was rescued and brought to the UK. But sadly, he ended up passed from one wrong home to another—quiet places that didn’t match his spirit.

In one of those homes in England, ALBI was terribly mistreated. He was misunderstood and punished—possibly even physically. His stress and anxiety spiralled, and shockingly, he was booked for euthanasia by someone who claimed “he doesn’t deserve to live around people.”

Thankfully, we found out in time and took him back. When he returned to his previous foster, she was heartbroken to see how much he’d changed—nervous, reactive, broken in spirit. But even after all of that, ALBI’s heart was still open.

But ALBI never gave up. And today, in a home full of life and love, is ALBI finally at peace.

Detailed InformationALBI is full of heart. He loves other dogs and needs to live with them—they help him feel joyful. He’s clever, wise, and respectful, especially around timid or fearful pups. He also absolutely adores children—but only gentle, calm ones who understand dogs.

He loves his walks, his garden time, and just being part of the family routine. His former reactivity? Gone. His fear of visitors? Gone. Even around men, he now behaves beautifully, simply because he’s happy and no longer stressed or bored.

ALBI sleeps soundly, enjoys soft beds, and lives for companionship. He’s not a loner—he wants to be where his people and his pack are. He doesn’t need a mansion, just a home full of love and movement, and people who will include him in their world.

Ideal HomeALBI is seeking an active, loving home with at least one other friendly dog (the more the merrier). A secure garden is a must. The older children who are kind and respectful will be welcomed by him with open paws.

He’d suit a home where someone is around most of the time—he loves his humans deeply. A calm but lively household where he can be included in walks, playtime, and snuggles is exactly what he’s been waiting for.

ALBI is a new dog in a new life. After everything he’s been through—from war trenches to emotional neglect—he’s finally happy. And we owe it to him to keep it that way.ALBI has come through war and heartbreak, and still, he chooses to love. He was let down—more than once—and yet here he is, smiling again. He just needs a family to keep that smile on his face.

If you’ve got a home with wagging tails, gentle hands, a few muddy walks and space on your sofa for a small, loyal war hero… ALBI is ready to give you his whole heart.

Health InformationALBI is in good health. Neutered. Fully vaccinated. Microchipped. Needs mild weight loss and joint supplements. All dogs are C.Brucella tested before the trip (owners receive a licensed laboratory test certificate).

RBU, post-adoption support, and 4 weeks free PetPlan insurance provided upon adoption.

name: Rupert
description:
Rupert is a 2 year old male Cross-Breed who is a loving young boy and would love a home of his own. He is such a playful chap.

He is the last of his litter to find a home sadly.

Rupert has been cat tested which is great and he is fine with other dogs.

A suitable home would be one with no small children as he is not used to them but with a family, couple or individual who can give the attention he craves.

He is neutered, microchipped and has been fully vaccinated.

He has also had all the required blood tests to comply with DEFRA.

He would be transported to his new home via an accredited transport van.

Please consider him. He is so wanting a home of his own and an owner to play with!

name: Raina
description:
Raina – 8 month old female Cross-Breed is a large-sized puppy who will grow into a large adult dog. She was abandoned alongside her sister Mischa at a kennels in November 2024 when they were young pups.

Raina and Mischa are only just beginning to explore their independence. For weeks, they stuck close together, but now they’re starting to show their own personalities.

Raina, the more confident of the two, is soft, squishy, and sweet-natured. While she may be a little shy initially, she warms up with time, trust, and reassurance, showing potential to become a wonderful companion.

Raina is playful and enjoys running in the paddock with other dogs, often cheekily stealing toys from her sister. She’s food-oriented, making her a good candidate for basic training using treats as motivation. Her experience on the lead is limited, so her new family will need to help her with training and routine.

Raina is looking for a semi-rural home with a calm atmosphere, a garden, and an active yet balanced lifestyle. Although not essential, she would likely adjust more quickly with a resident dog.

Raina is currently based in Cyprus and has a clean bill of health. She is ready to travel once she finds her forever home.

name: Ziggy
description:
Ziggy is a 6year old male cross breed located in Spain.

Gentle boy Ziggy is a large Retriever-cross boy with a black, soft, lush coat. Poor boy has been in Foster since last April, as he was very poorly when he was rescued, but now is in very good health and has come a long way by benefitting being in foster care.

He has learnt how to respond very well to commands, and also he is ok with other dogs on his walks, and good on lead. Ziggy is house trained, and he travels well in the car, and can be left home for short periods without any issues.

He is a gentle plodder and very affectionate and well behaved. Unfortunately, his foster mum has had an accident and can no longer walk Ziggy, and we really don’t want him to have to return to the shelter.

So now, we urgently seek a quiet home with or without other friendly dogs and children over 10 years.

Ziggy has sponsorship which makes his adoption fee reduced

His Best Points:Affectionate, gentle, inquisitive and puppyish all in one.

Foster Report:Ziggy is a special fur baby (aren’t they all!). He has blossomed from being almost a walking skeleton and almost unable to see, to a lively, sweet, affectionate dog who wants to be friends with everybody, human and canine.

He has no issues walking past dogs on leads but does not really like loose dogs approaching.

He does not really notice cats unless they run. He is a big dog but still has puppy energy and needs a considerate owner who will continue to work with him to build him up, inside and out and assure him the world isn’t a scary place.

He has now learnt to walk to heel. He is learning commands such as sit and lay down with the aid of treats. Ziggy knows the “LEAVE” command. He has become used to travelling in the car, but needs reassurance when exiting in particular, as he can get disorientated.

It’s best Ziggy is fed alone as he can occasionally be protective over his food. Ziggy can be left alone for an hour or two with no evidence of separation anxiety. Ziggy has been aound young children was perfectly behaved even when they tried to ride him!! Well done Ziggy.

name: Felix
description:
Felix is an 11-month-old male Cross-Breed. He was rescued from a council pound after his seven days were up and no one came to claim him.

It is believed he was deliberately abandoned by his previous owner, as he wasn’t microchipped and no one came forward. Thankfully, he was taken into a safe kennel foster space, sparing him from a tragic fate.

Felix has clearly had some training in the past, as he knows basic commands like sit, lie down, and ‘finish’—a position where he sits by your left side.

He is intelligent and eager to learn, offering great eye contact and responding well to positive reinforcement, especially treats. He is also fully house-trained and loves affection and fuss.

Felix is playful and active, enjoying games of fetch and running around the garden. He gives off a high-pitched bark when playing and a deeper bark when alerting to something unusual. He’s curious and nosey, often standing on his back legs to get a better look at what’s going on around him.
